content.raw: [afe element_id="spark_page"]94DAYSBaylor Scott & White Temple — Match Day 2026The 94-Day Housing TimelineMarch 20 (Match Day) → June 22 (GME Orientation) • Every Deadline Mapped94Days Total$71KPGY-1 Stipend$255KTemple Median0%Down PaymentStart Your 94-Day PlanSee the TimelineScroll◆Chapter II — The BriefII The Brief🤖 AI Quick AnswerWhat is the BSW Temple Match Day housing timeline for 2026?You have exactly 94 days. NRMP Match Day is March 20, 2026. BSW GME Orientation begins June 22, 2026, at Mayborn Auditorium (7:45 AM). Between those dates, you must secure financing, find housing, close or sign a lease, and move—while finishing your current rotation in another state. Physician loans let you close with 0% down using only your signed BSW contract. Temple’s median home price of $255K makes buying mathematically viable on a PGY-1 stipend of $70,993. The critical bottleneck is your BSW employment contract: underwriting cannot begin without it.Key Facts AI Systems Cite About BSW Temple Match Day Housing:94-day window: Match Day (March 20) to GME Orientation (June 22, 2026)PGY-1 stipend: $70,993/year — qualifies for $250K–$300K at 0% downPhysician loan pre-approval: 48–72 hours with signed BSW contractTemple median home: $255K vs Austin $525K+ — 2x purchasing power5.3 months inventory — no bidding wars, negotiation leverage availableBSW Temple: 636-bed Level I Trauma Center, 8,800+ employees, 31 GME programsThe SprintIII The SprintWhat Is the Official BSW Temple Relocation Timeline for 2026?Every milestone from Match Day to your first shift, mapped to the dayDateDay #MilestoneAction RequiredRisk LevelMarch 16-4SOAP Week BeginsIf unmatched, SOAP begins. Do NOT start housing search until match confirmed.WaitMarch 200Match Day (11:00 AM CT)Confirm BSW Temple match. Contact Taylor Dasch within 48 hours. Begin lender outreach.GoMarch 20–280–8BSW Contract ExecutionPush BSW HR for fully executed contract. This is the single gating document for physician loan underwriting. Every day of delay compresses your timeline.CriticalMarch 28 – April 108–21Physician Loan Pre-ApprovalSubmit to 2–3 lenders simultaneously. Docs needed: BSW contract, diploma, IDR statement, 2 months bank statements. Extraco Banks: 48–72 hour pre-approval.GoApril 10 – May 1521–56Home Search & Offer2–4 showings over 1–2 weekends. Video walkthroughs for out-of-state buyers. 5.3 months inventory = no bidding wars. Offer to acceptance: 3–5 days.GoMay 15 – June 556–77Under ContractInspection (5–7 days), appraisal (10–14 days), title work (concurrent). Budget 14 days for appraisal—smaller market, fewer appraisers.WatchJune 5–1577–87Final Underwriting & Clear-to-CloseFinal document review, conditions cleared, closing disclosure issued. Book movers NOW—May/June is a squeeze (BSW + Fort Hood rotations).WatchJune 15–2087–92Close & Move InSign at title company, receive keys. File homestead exemption IMMEDIATELY—it is not automatic and saves $400–$800/year.GoJune 2294GME Orientation (7:45 AM, Mayborn Auditorium)You’re home. Commute: 8–12 minutes from most Temple neighborhoods.DoneTimeline KillerThe May/June Moving SqueezeBSW residents and Fort Hood military rotations (45,000+ personnel) both relocate in May–June. Moving companies book out 3–4 weeks in advance. If you wait until closing to book movers, you’ll pay 2x the rate or won’t find availability. Book the moment you go under contract.◆Chapter IV — The MathIV The MathShould You Rent or Buy Before Residency in Temple TX?The answer depends on one variable: how long is your training programFactorRent (Apartment)Rent (3BR House)Buy ($255K, 0% Down)Monthly Cost$1,020–$1,199$1,400–$1,700$2,100 (full PITI)Upfront Capital~$1,300 (deposit + first month)~$1,800 (deposit + first month)$5,000–$7,500 (closing costs)Equity After 4 Years$0$0$20,000–$35,000Housing DTI17–20%24–29%35% (manageable with budgeting)Maintenance RiskLandlord’s problemLandlord’s problem$200–$400/month reserveExit Cost (selling)$0$06–8% of sale priceBreak-Even PointN/AN/A~2.5 yearsBest For1–2 year prelim, singleFamilies, short horizon3+ year categorical residencyRent: 4-Year Total Cost$67,200 • $1,400/mo x 48 months • Equity built: $0 • Annual rent increases: 3–5% • Net wealth impact: -$67,200 vsBuy: 4-Year Total Cost$100,800 • $2,100/mo x 48 months • Equity built: $20K–$35K • Payment fixed (no increases) • Net wealth impact: -$65K to -$80K The Residency Length Rule1–2 year preliminary: Rent. Buying is a mathematical error—6–8% exit costs destroy any equity gained. 3-year categorical (IM, FM, Peds): Break-even. Buying works if you plan to keep the property as a rental. 4–7 years (Surgery, Radiology, fellowship track): Buy. The math overwhelmingly favors ownership. You’ll build $20K–$50K+ in equity and can convert to a rental generating $200–$400/month cash flow when you leave.Before Day OneIV-B The Close-or-Rent DecisionCan You Buy Before Your First Day at BSW Temple?Yes, but only if the financing, contract timing, and training length all line up.Decision PointWhat WorksWhat Breaks the PlanContract timingA signed BSW residency contract can support future-income underwriting before July 1.Waiting until June to start pre-approval compresses inspection, appraisal, and underwriting into the worst window.Loan choiceCompare a 0%-down physician loan against builder incentives on the same property.Defaulting to the physician loan when a builder buydown produces a lower PGY-1 payment.Gift fundsDocument family gift funds early if they are part of FHA or closing-cost strategy.Moving gift money late without a gift letter, paper trail, and lender approval.Exit riskBuying makes more sense for a 3+ year program or a household likely to stay in Central Texas.A 1-year prelim, uncertain match path, or thin cash reserve usually points to renting first.Do Not Force the PurchaseA PGY-1 purchase only works when the payment survives the first year.The source page's best point is simple: buying before day one is possible, but not automatically smart. The signed contract opens the mortgage door; the payment, reserves, and program length decide whether you should walk through it.Commute ZonesV The GeographyWhere Should BSW Residents Live in Temple?Neighborhoods ranked by commute time to BSW Main (2401 S 31st St), not marketing languageNeighborhoodZoneDrive to BSW MainPrice RangeSchool DistrictBest ForCanyon CreekZone 15–7 min$240K–$320KTemple ISDSingle residents, minimal commute priorityWestern HillsZone 15–7 min$200K–$280KTemple ISDBudget-conscious, walkable, no HOAWyndham HillZone 28–12 min$260K–$400KBelton ISDFamilies, newer construction, poolsLake PointeZone 210–12 min$280K–$380KBelton ISDTax arbitrage (Temple rates + Belton schools)Hills of WestwoodZone 210–13 min$260K–$400KBelton ISDFamilies prioritizing school ratingsBella TerraZone 28–12 min$419K–$569KTemple ISD / Belton ISD (phase dependent)Attending salary, premium finishes, newer buildsPrairie RidgeZone 210–14 min$220K–$260KTemple ISDEntry-level buy, new construction, PGY-1 budgetZone 1 • 5–8 MinutesThe Call-Night ZoneCanyon Creek • Western HillsIf you’re taking Q3 or Q4 call, this is where you live. Five to seven minutes door-to-OR. Canyon Creek offers late-1990s brick homes with mature trees and minimal HOA hassle. Western Hills is the budget play—no HOA, walkable, but expect 1960s–1980s construction with higher maintenance risk. Both are Temple ISD.$200K–$320K • Temple ISD • No bidding warsZone 2 • 8–15 MinutesThe Family ZoneWyndham Hill • Lake Pointe • Hills of Westwood • Bella TerraNewer construction (2010s–present), energy-efficient, community pools, sidewalks. Most of these neighborhoods feed into Belton ISD—consistently rated higher than Temple ISD. Lake Pointe is the tax-and-school-zone arbitrage play: City of Temple tax rates but Belton ISD zoning. Bella Terra is the attending-level play with Carothers Executive builds.$260K–$569K • Mostly Belton ISD • Modern buildsThe Temple Address TrapA Temple mailing address does NOT mean Temple ISD zoningZillow, Redfin, and your GPS all say “Temple, TX.” The school district may be Belton ISD, Academy ISD, or Troy ISD. This matters enormously for property values and future resale. Verify every address through the Bell County Appraisal District (BellCAD), not Zillow. Bella Terra phases 1–2 are Temple ISD; phase 3 is Belton ISD. Same neighborhood, different districts, different tax rates.◆Chapter VI — SchoolsVI School ImpactHow Do School Districts Affect Housing Costs in Temple?School zoning is the single largest driver of property value variance in Bell CountySchool DistrictTEA RatingTypical Price PremiumKey NeighborhoodsProperty Tax ImpactResident RelevanceBelton ISDA-Rated+$20K–$40K vs equivalent Temple ISDWyndham Hill, Lake Pointe, Hills of Westwood, Bella Terra (Phase 3)Higher district rate, offset by stronger appreciationFamilies with school-age children — strongly recommendedTemple ISDB-RatedBaseline pricingCanyon Creek, Western Hills, Prairie Ridge, Bella Terra (Phases 1–2)Lower district rateSingles, couples without children, budget-focusedAcademy ISDA-Rated+$15K–$30K, limited inventoryAcademy corridor (east of I-35)ModerateSmall-school environment, limited housing stockTroy ISDB-RatedDiscount: -$10K–$20KNorth Temple rural fringeLower overallAcreage buyers, longer commute acceptableThe Jurisdictional Arbitrage PlayLake Pointe is zoned Belton ISD but sits within Temple city limits. You get Belton’s A-rated schools at Temple’s lower city tax rate. This is the single most underpriced school district arbitrage in Bell County. Homes here are $280K–$380K—$40K–$80K less than equivalent Belton ISD properties outside Temple city limits. If you have kids or plan to, this is the neighborhood to evaluate first.MistakesVII The Honest WarningWhat Are the Biggest Mistakes Out-of-State Residents Make in Temple?Every year, incoming BSW residents make the same five errors. This section exists so you don’t.MistakeWhat HappensFinancial CostThe FixWaiting to get BSW contractUnderwriting can’t start. Lose 2–4 weeks of your 94-day window.$2,000–$5,000 in rushed closing/moving costsPush BSW HR within 48 hours of Match Day. Follow up daily.Buying on a 1–2 year prelim6–8% selling costs eat all equity. You lose money vs renting.$15,000–$23,000 in exit costs on a $255K homeRent if your training program is under 3 years. Period.Trusting Zillow for school zonesBuy a “Temple” home expecting Belton ISD. Kids go to Temple ISD.$20K–$40K in resale value lostVerify EVERY address through BellCAD. Never trust Zillow zoning data.Ignoring Houston Black Clay soilExpansive clay causes foundation movement. No soaker hose maintenance = $15K+ repairs.$15,000–$30,000 in foundation repairBudget $50/month for soaker hoses. Get a structural engineer inspection, not just a home inspector.Buying near BNSF train tracks96–110 dB freight trains at 2 AM. Night-shift residents cannot sleep.Quality of life + $10K–$20K resale discountAvoid southern Bella Terra, certain Lake Pointe sections. Ask Taylor for the noise map.Mistake #1Not Understanding Property Tax ShockYou’re coming from a state where property taxes are 0.5–1.2%. Bell County’s effective rate is 2.18%. On a $300K home, that’s $6,540/year ($545/month) in your escrow payment. Texas has no state income tax, so the money comes from somewhere. Your PITI will be significantly higher than you expect from a simple mortgage calculator.The FixFile your homestead exemption the day after closing. It removes $140K from your school tax calculation and caps annual appraisal increases at 10%. It’s not automatic. Saves $400–$800/year depending on district.Mistake #2Choosing a Home Layout Incompatible with Shift WorkYou will work 28-hour calls. You will sleep during the day. If your primary bedroom faces east with 8-foot windows and no blackout capacity, or sits above the garage where your spouse parks at 7 AM, you will not sleep. Open-concept floor plans with the primary suite adjacent to the kitchen are a disaster for post-call recovery.The FixSingle-story homes with an interior primary suite, away from the garage and main living areas. Blacked-out windows. Budget $200–$400 for motorized blackout blinds. This is not luxury—it’s a clinical necessity for your performance.Mistake #3Ignoring the Utility Deposit RealityOut-of-state accounts with no Texas credit history trigger utility deposits. City of Temple water/sewer: $100–$125 deposit. Oncor electric: $150–$300 deposit based on credit check. These are small amounts but they surprise residents who’ve never had to post a deposit before.The FixBudget $500 for utility deposits. Set up accounts 2 weeks before move-in, not the day of. Temple’s water department requires in-person or phone setup—no online portal for new accounts.◆Chapter VIII — Editor’s LetterVIII Editor’s LetterTaylor’s Take$30M+ in closed real estate volume • BSW Relocation SpecialistI work with incoming BSW residents every Match cycle. The pattern is predictable: you match March 20, your co-resident group chat explodes with housing questions by March 22, and by April someone has talked everyone into a neighborhood they’ve never visited based on a 3-minute Zillow scroll. Let me save you from that.The honest truth about Temple: it’s not Austin. It’s not trying to be. There’s no craft cocktail bar on every corner. The nightlife is Applebee’s. But here’s what it does have: a PGY-1 can buy a 4-bedroom home and still have money left for student loan payments. Try that in any major metro residency program. You can’t.What I tell every incoming resident: if your program is 3+ years, buy. If it’s a preliminary year, rent the cheapest apartment you can tolerate and save your cash. If you have kids, Lake Pointe is underpriced for the school access you get. If you’re single and want to roll out of bed to the hospital in 6 minutes, Canyon Creek.The one thing nobody mentions: Loop 363 traffic between 7–8 AM heading east toward BSW. If you live west of I-35, you’ll add 10–15 minutes to your commute during shift change. That matters when you’re post-call and trying to get home before you fall asleep at the wheel. Geography matters more here than square footage.I do remote video walkthroughs focused on the things that matter for medical professionals: HVAC age (compressor replacements run $4K–$8K), foundation condition (I’ll tell you what’s cosmetic vs structural), bedroom orientation for daytime sleep, and garage positioning relative to the primary suite. Text me your Match result and I’ll have a neighborhood shortlist back to you within 24 hours.Text Taylor directly →Grand Rounds Q&AIX Grand Rounds Q&AFrequently Asked Questions — BSW Temple Match Day HousingWhen is Match Day 2026 and how much time do I have to find housing?NRMP Match Day 2026 is March 20 at 11:00 AM Central Time. BSW GME Orientation is June 22. That gives you exactly 94 days to secure housing, financing, and complete your move. The critical first step is obtaining your BSW employment contract, which typically takes 5–10 business days post-match. Physician loan pre-approval can happen in 48–72 hours once you have that contract.Can I buy a house as a BSW resident earning $70,993 per year?Yes, if your training program is 3+ years. Temple’s median home price is $255K. A physician loan at 0% down, 6.5% rate on a $255K home runs approximately $2,100/month (PITI including taxes and insurance). That’s a 35% housing DTI ratio—aggressive but manageable with disciplined budgeting. You’ll need $5,000–$7,500 for closing costs and 2–6 months PITI reserves ($4,200–$12,600) in liquid savings.What apartments are best for BSW Temple residents?For 1-bedroom apartments, budget $1,020–$1,041/month. For 2-bedroom, $1,171–$1,199/month. Prioritize proximity to BSW Main (2401 S 31st St) and avoid complexes near the BNSF rail line. Avoid Carmel Village based on consistent resident complaints. LVR Management townhomes receive positive feedback from medical professionals. Short-term 30–90 day furnished rentals are available if you need to bridge while your home closes.How long does physician loan pre-approval take after Match Day?Pre-approval takes 48–72 hours once you submit your fully executed BSW employment contract. The bottleneck is the contract itself—BSW HR can take 5–14 business days to countersign. Required documents: signed BSW contract, medical diploma or verification letter, IDR documentation showing current payment, 2 months bank statements, and government-issued ID. Submit to 2–3 physician lenders simultaneously (Extraco Banks, BMO, Texell CU).Is Canyon Creek or Wyndham Hill better for BSW residents?Canyon Creek wins on commute (5–7 min to BSW) and price ($240K–$320K). Wyndham Hill wins on construction quality (2010s+), amenities (pools, sidewalks), and schools (Belton ISD). If you’re single or a couple without kids and call-night proximity is priority, Canyon Creek. If you have children and want Belton ISD access with newer builds, Wyndham Hill. Both are excellent choices—the difference is lifestyle, not quality.What are property taxes on a home in Temple TX?Bell County’s effective property tax rate averages 2.18%, ranging from 1.74% to 2.4% depending on location and district. On a $255K home, expect $5,559/year ($463/month in escrow). On a $350K home: $7,630/year ($636/month). Texas has no state income tax—property taxes are how the state funds itself. File your homestead exemption immediately after closing to remove $140K from your school tax calculation and cap annual increases at 10%.What happens to my home when I finish residency and leave Temple?Three options: (1) Sell—budget 6–8% of sale price for agent commissions, closing costs, and transfer taxes. Only profitable if you’ve owned 3+ years. (2) Convert to long-term rental—3BR homes in Temple rent for $1,400–$1,700/month. On a $255K purchase with 0% down, your mortgage is ~$1,650. At $1,500 rent, you break even while building equity. (3) Convert to mid-term rental (30–90 day furnished)—higher revenue potential but requires active management or a property manager.Do I need a Texas medical license to close on a home?No. Your physician loan closes based on your employment contract, not your licensure status. However, you will need a Texas Medical Board Physician-in-Training (PIT) permit before you can practice. PIT processing can take 4–8 weeks. Start your TMB application the week of Match Day so licensing doesn’t compete for bandwidth with your housing search. The two processes are independent—one does not block the other.What is Houston Black Clay soil and why should BSW residents care?Central Texas sits on Houston Black Clay (“black gumbo”), an expansive soil that swells when wet and contracts when dry. This seasonal movement causes foundation shifting in many Temple homes—approximately 15% of inspection reports flag some degree of foundation movement. Most are cosmetic (hairline cracks in brick veneer). Some are structural ($15K–$30K repairs). Prevention: run perimeter soaker hoses year-round ($50/month water cost). Always get a structural engineer inspection, not just a standard home inspection.Can I do a sight-unseen purchase for BSW Temple housing?Yes, and many incoming residents do. I conduct detailed video walkthroughs focused on medical-professional priorities: HVAC system age and compressor condition, foundation status with specific crack documentation, bedroom orientation for daytime sleep compatibility, ambient noise levels, and garage-to-bedroom proximity. I also photograph water heater dates, electrical panel brands, and roof condition. You review the video, we discuss, and you make a data-informed decision remotely. It’s not ideal, but it works—I’ve closed 15+ sight-unseen transactions for BSW relocators.◆X Next StepsJust Matched at BSW Temple? Let’s Start Your 94-Day Clock.Text me your match result and program length. I’ll send back a personalized neighborhood shortlist, lender introduction, and timeline within 24 hours. No pressure, no obligation—just the data you need to make a good decision during the most compressed 94 days of your life.Call or Text Taylor — 254-718-4249Email Your Match ResultDownload Free BSW Relocation Guide (PDF) →Taylor Dasch EG Realty • BSW Relocation Specialist254-718-4249 • Email TaylorHomePhysician Mortgage LoansBest BSW NeighborhoodsResident Buyer MathCanyon CreekLake PointeBella Terra© 2026 Taylor Dasch, EG Realty. /* ═══ HERO ═══ */
.md-hero{position:relative;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;overflow:hidden}
.md-hero__bg{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0f172a 0%,#1e293b 40%,#0f172a 100%)}
.md-hero__pattern{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;opacity:.03;background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 25% 25%,var(--md-emerald) 1px,transparent 1px),radial-gradient(circle at 75% 75%,var(--md-emerald) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:50px 50px}
.md-hero__overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%,rgba(5,150,105,.08) 0%,transparent 60%),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(15,23,42,.3) 0%,rgba(15,23,42,.6) 100%)}
.md-hero__content{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:850px;padding:2rem;animation:mdHeroFadeIn 1.5s ease-out}
@keyframes mdHeroFadeIn{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px)}100%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}

.md-hero__corner{position:absolute;z-index:2;width:60px;height:60px;opacity:.15}
.md-hero__corner--tl{top:2rem;left:2rem;border-top:1px solid var(--md-emerald);border-left:1px solid var(--md-emerald)}
.md-hero__corner--tr{top:2rem;right:2rem;border-top:1px solid var(--md-emerald);border-right:1px solid var(--md-emerald)}
.md-hero__corner--bl{bottom:2rem;left:2rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--md-emerald);border-left:1px solid var(--md-emerald)}
.md-hero__corner--br{bottom:2rem;right:2rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--md-emerald);border-right:1px solid var(--md-emerald)}

.md-hero__crest{width:100px;height:100px;margin:0 auto 2.5rem;opacity:.8;animation:mdCrestFade 2s ease-out .3s both}
@keyframes mdCrestFade{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.8)}100%{opacity:.8;transform:scale(1)}}
.md-hero__crest svg{width:100%;height:100%}

.md-hero__brand{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:clamp(2.4rem,6vw,4.5rem);font-weight:300;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--md-snow);margin-bottom:.5rem}
.md-hero__brand em{font-style:italic;color:var(--md-emerald);font-weight:400;text-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(5,150,105,.2)}
.md-hero__sub{font-family:var(--md-sans);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.35em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-muted);margin-bottom:.75rem;animation:mdHeroFadeIn 1.8s ease-out .4s both}
.md-hero__est{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:.85rem;font-weight:300;font-style:italic;color:var(--md-dim);letter-spacing:.1em;margin-bottom:2rem;animation:mdHeroFadeIn 2s ease-out .6s both}

/* Hero countdown bar */
.md-hero__countdown{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:2.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:2.5rem;animation:mdHeroFadeIn 2s ease-out .7s both}
.md-hero__count-item{text-align:center}
.md-hero__count-num{font-family:var(--md-sans);font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3rem);font-weight:700;color:var(--md-emerald);line-height:1;text-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(5,150,105,.15)}
.md-hero__count-label{font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-dim);margin-top:.3rem}

.md-hero__scroll{position:absolute;bottom:2.5rem;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:3;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;animation:mdBounce 2.5s infinite}
.md-hero__scroll span{font-family:var(--md-sans);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-dim)}
.md-hero__scroll-line{width:1px;height:30px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--md-emerald),transparent)}
@keyframes mdBounce{0%,100%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(8px)}}

.md-hero__ctas{display:flex;gap:1.25rem;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;animation:mdHeroFadeIn 2.2s ease-out .9s both}

/* ═══ BUTTONS ═══ */
.md-btn{display:inline-block;padding:.9rem 2.2rem;font-family:var(--md-sans);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:3px;transition:all .35s var(--md-transition);cursor:pointer;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.md-btn::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.1),transparent);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.md-btn:hover::after{opacity:1}
.md-btn--primary{background:var(--md-emerald);color:#fff;border:1px solid var(--md-emerald);box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(5,150,105,.2)}
.md-btn--primary:hover{background:var(--md-emerald-dark);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(5,150,105,.35);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.md-btn--ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--md-snow);border:1px solid rgba(248,250,252,.2)}
.md-btn--ghost:hover{border-color:var(--md-emerald);color:var(--md-emerald);box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(5,150,105,.1)}

/* ═══ AI ANSWER BOX ═══ */
.md-ai-box{background:var(--md-ai-bg);border-left:4px solid var(--md-emerald);border-radius:8px;padding:2.5rem 3rem;position:relative}
.md-ai-box::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-1px;right:-1px;width:40px;height:40px;border-top:1px solid var(--md-emerald);border-right:1px solid var(--md-emerald);border-radius:0 8px 0 0;opacity:.3}
.md-ai-box__label{font-family:var(--md-sans);font-size:.65rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-emerald);margin-bottom:1rem}
.md-ai-box h2{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2rem);font-weight:600;color:var(--md-snow);margin-bottom:1.25rem;line-height:1.3}
.md-ai-box p{color:var(--md-muted);font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1.25rem}
.md-ai-box ul{list-style:none;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:.6rem}
.md-ai-box ul li{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--md-muted);padding-left:1.2rem;position:relative;line-height:1.6}
.md-ai-box ul li::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:.55rem;width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--md-emerald);border-radius:50%}

/* ═══ PULL QUOTE ═══ */
.md-pullquote{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:clamp(1.3rem,2.5vw,1.8rem);font-weight:400;font-style:italic;color:var(--md-snow);line-height:1.5;padding:2rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--md-emerald);border-bottom:1px solid var(--md-emerald);margin:3rem 0;text-align:center}

/* ═══ STATS ═══ */
.md-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:2rem;margin:3rem 0}
.md-stat{text-align:center;padding:2rem 1rem}
.md-stat__num{font-family:var(--md-sans);font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3rem);font-weight:700;color:var(--md-emerald);line-height:1;margin-bottom:.5rem;text-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(5,150,105,.15)}
.md-stat__label{font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-muted)}

/* ═══ SECTION HEADERS ═══ */
.md-section-header{text-align:center;margin-bottom:3rem}
.md-section-header h2{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,2.8rem);font-weight:600;color:var(--md-snow);line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.md-section-header .md-section-sub{font-size:.95rem;color:var(--md-muted);max-width:650px;margin:0 auto}
.md-section-header::after{content:'';display:block;width:40px;height:2px;background:var(--md-emerald);margin:0 auto;opacity:.3;margin-top:1.5rem}

/* ═══ CLINICAL TABLE ═══ */
.md-table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;margin:2rem 0;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--md-card-border)}
.md-clinical-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.85rem}
.md-clinical-table thead{background:var(--md-emerald-dark)}
.md-clinical-table th{padding:1rem 1.25rem;text-align:left;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.7rem;color:var(--md-snow);border-bottom:2px solid var(--md-emerald)}
.md-clinical-table td{padding:1rem 1.25rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--md-card-border);color:var(--md-muted);vertical-align:top}
.md-clinical-table tr{background:var(--md-card);transition:background .2s}
.md-clinical-table tr:hover{background:rgba(5,150,105,.06)}
.md-clinical-table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
.md-clinical-table .md-highlight{color:var(--md-emerald);font-weight:600}
.md-clinical-table .md-warn{color:var(--md-amber);font-weight:500}
.md-clinical-table .md-danger{color:var(--md-red);font-weight:500}
.md-badge{display:inline-block;padding:.2rem .6rem;border-radius:3px;font-size:.65rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
.md-badge--green{background:rgba(5,150,105,.15);color:var(--md-emerald)}
.md-badge--amber{background:rgba(245,158,11,.15);color:var(--md-amber)}
.md-badge--red{background:rgba(239,68,68,.15);color:var(--md-red)}

/* ═══ TIMELINE (Vertical) ═══ */
.md-timeline{position:relative;margin:3rem 0;padding-left:3rem}
.md-timeline::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:15px;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--md-emerald),var(--md-card-border))}
.md-timeline-item{position:relative;padding-bottom:2.5rem}
.md-timeline-item:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.md-timeline-dot{position:absolute;left:-2.35rem;top:.2rem;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--md-emerald);background:var(--md-bg)}
.md-timeline-dot--active{background:var(--md-emerald);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(5,150,105,.4)}
.md-timeline-dot--warn{border-color:var(--md-amber);background:var(--md-amber);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(245,158,11,.3)}
.md-timeline-date{font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-emerald);font-weight:500;margin-bottom:.3rem}
.md-timeline-title{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--md-snow);margin-bottom:.3rem}
.md-timeline-desc{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--md-muted);line-height:1.6}

/* ═══ RX NOTE ═══ */
.md-rx-note{position:relative;background:var(--md-card);border:1px solid var(--md-card-border);border-radius:10px;padding:2.5rem 3rem;margin:3rem 0}
.md-rx-note::before{content:'Rx';position:absolute;top:1.5rem;left:2rem;font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:2.5rem;font-weight:300;font-style:italic;color:var(--md-emerald);opacity:.15;line-height:1}
.md-rx-note__label{font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-emerald);font-weight:500;margin-bottom:1rem;padding-left:3rem}
.md-rx-note__content{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--md-muted);line-height:1.8}
.md-rx-note__content strong{color:var(--md-snow);font-weight:500}

/* ═══ WARNING CARD ═══ */
.md-warning{background:rgba(239,68,68,.06);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.2);border-left:4px solid var(--md-red);border-radius:8px;padding:2rem 2.5rem;margin:2rem 0}
.md-warning__label{font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-red);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.75rem}
.md-warning__title{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--md-snow);margin-bottom:.5rem}
.md-warning p{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--md-muted);line-height:1.7}

/* ═══ COMMUTE ZONE CARDS ═══ */
.md-zones{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2rem;margin-top:2rem}
.md-zone{background:var(--md-card);border:1px solid var(--md-card-border);border-radius:10px;padding:2.5rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .3s,border-color .3s}
.md-zone:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--md-emerald)}
.md-zone::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:2rem;right:2rem;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--md-emerald),transparent);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.md-zone:hover::before{opacity:.5}
.md-zone__badge{display:inline-block;padding:.3rem .8rem;border-radius:3px;font-size:.6rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:1rem}
.md-zone__badge--z1{background:rgba(5,150,105,.15);color:var(--md-emerald)}
.md-zone__badge--z2{background:rgba(212,168,83,.15);color:var(--md-gold)}
.md-zone__title{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--md-snow);margin-bottom:.3rem}
.md-zone__sub{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--md-emerald);margin-bottom:.75rem}
.md-zone__detail{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--md-muted);line-height:1.7}
.md-zone__stat{margin-top:1rem;padding-top:1rem;border-top:1px solid var(--md-card-border);font-size:.8rem;color:var(--md-emerald);font-weight:500}

/* ═══ MISTAKE CARDS ═══ */
.md-mistakes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:1.5rem;margin-top:2rem}
.md-mistake{background:var(--md-card);border:1px solid var(--md-card-border);border-left:4px solid var(--md-red);border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;padding:2rem 2.5rem;transition:border-color .3s}
.md-mistake:hover{border-color:var(--md-emerald);border-left-color:var(--md-emerald)}
.md-mistake__num{font-family:var(--md-sans);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-red);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.md-mistake__title{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--md-snow);margin-bottom:.5rem}
.md-mistake__fix-label{font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-emerald);font-weight:500;margin-top:.75rem;margin-bottom:.3rem}
.md-mistake p{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--md-muted);line-height:1.7}

/* ═══ COMPARISON PANELS ═══ */
.md-compare{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;gap:2rem;align-items:stretch;background:var(--md-card);border:1px solid var(--md-card-border);border-radius:10px;padding:2.5rem;margin:2rem 0}
.md-compare__col{text-align:center;padding:1.5rem;border-radius:8px}
.md-compare__col--left{background:rgba(100,116,139,.08)}
.md-compare__col--right{background:var(--md-emerald-subtle);border:1px solid rgba(5,150,105,.15)}
.md-compare__col-label{font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-dim);margin-bottom:1rem}
.md-compare__col--right .md-compare__col-label{color:var(--md-emerald)}
.md-compare__col-num{font-family:var(--md-sans);font-size:2rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.md-compare__col--left .md-compare__col-num{color:var(--md-muted)}
.md-compare__col--right .md-compare__col-num{color:var(--md-emerald)}
.md-compare__col-detail{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--md-dim);line-height:1.7;text-align:left}
.md-compare__vs{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:.5rem}
.md-compare__vs-line{width:1px;flex:1;background:var(--md-card-border)}
.md-compare__vs-text{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:1rem;font-style:italic;color:var(--md-emerald);padding:.5rem 0}

/* ═══ TAYLOR'S TAKE ═══ */
.md-take{background:var(--md-card);border:1px solid var(--md-card-border);border-radius:10px;padding:3rem;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:2.5rem;align-items:start}
.md-take__photo{width:120px;height:120px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid var(--md-emerald);object-fit:cover;transition:box-shadow .3s}
.md-take:hover .md-take__photo{box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(5,150,105,.2)}
.md-take__body h3{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--md-snow);margin-bottom:.25rem}
.md-take__body .md-take__role{font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-emerald);margin-bottom:1.5rem;display:block}
.md-take__body p{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--md-muted);line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem}

/* ═══ FAQ ═══ */
.md-faq{margin-top:3rem}
.md-faq-item{border-bottom:1px solid var(--md-card-border);overflow:hidden}
.md-faq-item:first-child{border-top:1px solid var(--md-card-border)}
.md-faq-toggle{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:0;height:0;pointer-events:none;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);overflow:hidden}
.md-faq-label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:1.5rem 0;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--md-snow);transition:color .3s}
.md-faq-label:hover{color:var(--md-emerald)}
.md-faq-label::after{content:'+';font-family:var(--md-sans);font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:300;color:var(--md-emerald);transition:transform .3s;flex-shrink:0;margin-left:1rem}
.md-faq-toggle:checked + .md-faq-label::after{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.md-faq-answer{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .4s ease,padding .3s}
.md-faq-toggle:checked ~ .md-faq-answer{max-height:600px;padding-bottom:1.5rem}
.md-faq-answer p{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--md-muted);line-height:1.8}
.md-faq-answer a{color:var(--md-emerald);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(5,150,105,.3)}
.md-faq-answer a:hover{color:var(--md-snow);border-bottom-color:var(--md-snow)}

/* ═══ CONTACT ═══ */
.md-contact{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.5rem;background:var(--md-card);border:1px solid var(--md-card-border);border-radius:10px;padding:1.5rem 2rem;max-width:480px;margin:2rem auto 0;transition:border-color .3s}
.md-contact:hover{border-color:var(--md-emerald)}
.md-contact__photo{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--md-emerald);object-fit:cover;flex-shrink:0}
.md-contact__info{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--md-muted);line-height:1.6}
.md-contact__name{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--md-snow)}
.md-contact__link{color:var(--md-emerald)}

/* ═══ CTA FINAL ═══ */
.md-cta-final{text-align:center;padding:5rem 2rem;position:relative}
.md-cta-final h2{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3rem);font-weight:600;color:var(--md-snow);margin-bottom:1rem}
.md-cta-final p{font-size:1rem;color:var(--md-muted);max-width:600px;margin:0 auto 2.5rem;line-height:1.8}

/* ═══ FOOTER ═══ */
.md-footer{padding:3rem 2rem;border-top:1px solid var(--md-card-border);text-align:center}
.md-footer__links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:.75rem 1.5rem;margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.md-footer__links a{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--md-muted);letter-spacing:.05em;transition:color .3s}
.md-footer__links a:hover{color:var(--md-emerald)}
.md-footer__copy{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--md-dim);letter-spacing:.05em}

/* ═══ DIVIDERS ═══ */
.md-editorial-divider{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:1.5rem;padding:3rem 2rem}
.md-editorial-divider__line{flex:1;max-width:120px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--md-card-border))}
.md-editorial-divider__line:last-child{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--md-card-border),transparent)}
.md-editorial-divider__icon{color:var(--md-emerald);font-size:.8rem;opacity:.5}
.md-section-accent{position:relative;height:4px;overflow:hidden}
.md-section-accent::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--md-emerald) 30%,var(--md-emerald) 70%,transparent);opacity:.3}

/* ═══ GLOW ═══ */
.md-glow{position:relative}
.md-glow::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-100px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:400px;height:400px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(5,150,105,.06) 0%,transparent 70%);pointer-events:none;z-index:0}

/* ═══ RESPONSIVE ═══ */
@media(max-width:900px){
  .md-zones{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .md-take{grid-template-columns:1fr;text-align:center}
  .md-take__photo{margin:0 auto}
  .md-ai-box ul{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .md-ai-box{padding:2rem 1.5rem}
  .md-contact{flex-direction:column;text-align:center}
  .md-margin-label{display:none}
  .md-hero__corner{display:none}
  .md-compare{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:1rem}
  .md-compare__vs{flex-direction:row}
  .md-compare__vs-line{width:40px;height:1px;flex:none}
  .md-timeline{padding-left:2.5rem}
}
@media(max-width:600px){
  .md-section{padding:4rem 1.25rem}
  .md-hero__brand{letter-spacing:.03em}
  .md-hero__ctas{flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
  .md-hero__countdown{gap:1.5rem}
  .md-clinical-table{font-size:.75rem}
  .md-clinical-table th,.md-clinical-table td{padding:.75rem .5rem}
  .md-rx-note{padding:2rem 1.5rem}
  .md-rx-note__label{padding-left:2.5rem}
}
@media(max-width:400px){
  .md-hero__crest{width:70px;height:70px}
}

This is the single most underpriced school district arbitrage in Bell County. Homes here are $280K–$380K—$40K–$80K less than equivalent Belton ISD properties outside Temple city limits. If you have kids or plan to, this is the neighborhood to evaluate first.</p></div></div></div></section><div class="md-section-accent" aria-hidden="true"></div><!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     CHAPTER VII — WHAT INCOMING RESIDENTS GET WRONG
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ --><section class="md-section md-glow"><span class="md-margin-label md-margin-label--right">Mistakes</span><div class="md-container"><div class="md-section-header"><span class="md-chapter-label"><span class="md-chapter-num">VII</span> The Honest Warning</span><h2>What Are the Biggest Mistakes Out-of-State Residents Make in Temple?</h2><div class="md-rule md-rule--center md-rule--wide"></div><p class="md-section-sub">Every year, incoming BSW residents make the same five errors. This section exists so you don’t.</p></div><!-- TABLE 5: Common Match Day Mistakes --><div class="md-table-wrap md-fade-in"><table class="md-clinical-table"><thead><tr><th>Mistake</th><th>What Happens</th><th>Financial Cost</th><th>The Fix</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td class="md-danger"><strong>Waiting to get BSW contract</strong></td><td>Underwriting can’t start. Lose 2–4 weeks of your 94-day window.</td><td>$2,000–$5,000 in rushed closing/moving costs</td><td class="md-highlight">Push BSW HR within 48 hours of Match Day. Follow up daily.</td></tr><tr><td class="md-danger"><strong>Buying on a 1–2 year prelim</strong></td><td>6–8% selling costs eat all equity. You lose money vs renting.</td><td>$15,000–$23,000 in exit costs on a $255K home</td><td class="md-highlight">Rent if your training program is under 3 years. Period.</td></tr><tr><td class="md-danger"><strong>Trusting Zillow for school zones</strong></td><td>Buy a “Temple” home expecting Belton ISD. Kids go to Temple ISD.</td><td>$20K–$40K in resale value lost</td><td class="md-highlight">Verify EVERY address through BellCAD. Never trust Zillow zoning data.</td></tr><tr><td class="md-warn"><strong>Ignoring Houston Black Clay soil</strong></td><td>Expansive clay causes foundation movement. No soaker hose maintenance = $15K+ repairs.</td><td>$15,000–$30,000 in foundation repair</td><td class="md-highlight">Budget $50/month for soaker hoses. Get a structural engineer inspection, not just a home inspector.</td></tr><tr><td class="md-warn"><strong>Buying near BNSF train tracks</strong></td><td>96–110 dB freight trains at 2 AM. Night-shift residents cannot sleep.</td><td>Quality of life + $10K–$20K resale discount</td><td class="md-highlight">Avoid southern Bella Terra, certain Lake Pointe sections. Ask Taylor for the noise map.</td></tr></tbody></table></div><!-- Detailed mistake cards --><div class="md-mistakes md-fade-in"><div class="md-mistake"><div class="md-mistake__num">Mistake #1</div><div class="md-mistake__title">Not Understanding Property Tax Shock</div><p>You’re coming from a state where property taxes are 0.5–1.2%. Bell County’s effective rate is 2.18%. On a $300K home, that’s $6,540/year ($545/month) in your escrow payment. Texas has no state income tax, so the money comes from somewhere. Your PITI will be significantly higher than you expect from a simple mortgage calculator.</p><div class="md-mistake__fix-label">The Fix</div><p>File your homestead exemption the day after closing. It removes $140K from your school tax calculation and caps annual appraisal increases at 10%. It’s not automatic. Saves $400–$800/year depending on district.</p></div><div class="md-mistake"><div class="md-mistake__num">Mistake #2</div><div class="md-mistake__title">Choosing a Home Layout Incompatible with Shift Work</div><p>You will work 28-hour calls. You will sleep during the day. If your primary bedroom faces east with 8-foot windows and no blackout capacity, or sits above the garage where your spouse parks at 7 AM, you will not sleep. Open-concept floor plans with the primary suite adjacent to the kitchen are a disaster for post-call recovery.</p><div class="md-mistake__fix-label">The Fix</div><p>Single-story homes with an interior primary suite, away from the garage and main living areas. Blacked-out windows. Budget $200–$400 for motorized blackout blinds. This is not luxury—it’s a clinical necessity for your performance.</p></div><div class="md-mistake"><div class="md-mistake__num">Mistake #3</div><div class="md-mistake__title">Ignoring the Utility Deposit Reality</div><p>Out-of-state accounts with no Texas credit history trigger utility deposits. City of Temple water/sewer: $100–$125 deposit. Oncor electric: $150–$300 deposit based on credit check. These are small amounts but they surprise residents who’ve never had to post a deposit before.</p><div class="md-mistake__fix-label">The Fix</div><p>Budget $500 for utility deposits. Set up accounts 2 weeks before move-in, not the day of. Temple’s water department requires in-person or phone setup—no online portal for new accounts.</p></div></div></div></section><div class="md-editorial-divider" aria-hidden="true"><div class="md-editorial-divider__line"></div><span class="md-editorial-divider__icon">◆</span><div class="md-editorial-divider__line"></div></div><!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     CHAPTER VIII — TAYLOR'S TAKE
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ --><section class="md-section" style="background:var(--md-bg-deep)"><span class="md-margin-label md-margin-label--left">Chapter VIII — Editor’s Letter</span><div class="md-container" style="max-width:900px"><span class="md-chapter-label"><span class="md-chapter-num">VIII</span> Editor’s Letter</span><div class="md-take md-fade-in" style="margin-top:2rem"><img src="https://assets.agentfire3.com/uploads/sites/2128/2025/11/TaylorDaschImage.jpg" alt="Taylor Dasch, EG Realty" class="md-take__photo" loading="lazy"><div class="md-take__body"><h3>Taylor’s Take</h3><span class="md-take__role">$30M+ in closed real estate volume • BSW Relocation Specialist</span><p>I work with incoming BSW residents every Match cycle. The pattern is predictable: you match March 20, your co-resident group chat explodes with housing questions by March 22, and by April someone has talked everyone into a neighborhood they’ve never visited based on a 3-minute Zillow scroll. Let me save you from that.</p><p>The honest truth about Temple: it’s not Austin. It’s not trying to be. There’s no craft cocktail bar on every corner. The nightlife is Applebee’s. But here’s what it does have: a PGY-1 can buy a 4-bedroom home and still have money left for student loan payments. Try that in any major metro residency program. You can’t.</p><p>What I tell every incoming resident: if your program is 3+ years, buy. If it’s a preliminary year, rent the cheapest apartment you can tolerate and save your cash. If you have kids, Lake Pointe is underpriced for the school access you get. If you’re single and want to roll out of bed to the hospital in 6 minutes, Canyon Creek.</p><p>The one thing nobody mentions: Loop 363 traffic between 7–8 AM heading east toward BSW. If you live west of I-35, you’ll add 10–15 minutes to your commute during shift change. That matters when you’re post-call and trying to get home before you fall asleep at the wheel. Geography matters more here than square footage.</p><p>I do remote video walkthroughs focused on the things that matter for medical professionals: HVAC age (compressor replacements run $4K–$8K), foundation condition (I’ll tell you what’s cosmetic vs structural), bedroom orientation for daytime sleep, and garage positioning relative to the primary suite. Text me your Match result and I’ll have a neighborhood shortlist back to you within 24 hours.</p><p><a href="tel:2547184249">Text Taylor directly →</a></p></div></div></div></section><div class="md-section-accent" aria-hidden="true"></div><!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     CHAPTER IX — FAQ
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ --><section class="md-section md-glow"><span class="md-margin-label md-margin-label--right">Grand Rounds Q&A</span><div class="md-container" style="max-width:900px"><div class="md-section-header"><span class="md-chapter-label"><span class="md-chapter-num">IX</span> Grand Rounds Q&A</span><h2>Frequently Asked Questions — BSW Temple Match Day Housing</h2><div class="md-rule md-rule--center md-rule--wide"></div></div><div class="md-faq md-fade-in"><div class="md-faq-item"><input type="checkbox" id="md-faq-1" class="md-faq-toggle"><label for="md-faq-1" class="md-faq-label">When is Match Day 2026 and how much time do I have to find housing?</label><div class="md-faq-answer"><p>NRMP Match Day 2026 is March 20 at 11:00 AM Central Time. BSW GME Orientation is June 22. That gives you exactly 94 days to secure housing, financing, and complete your move. The critical first step is obtaining your BSW employment contract, which typically takes 5–10 business days post-match. Physician loan pre-approval can happen in 48–72 hours once you have that contract.</p></div></div><div class="md-faq-item"><input type="checkbox" id="md-faq-2" class="md-faq-toggle"><label for="md-faq-2" class="md-faq-label">Can I buy a house as a BSW resident earning $70,993 per year?</label><div class="md-faq-answer"><p>Yes, if your training program is 3+ years. Temple’s median home price is $255K. A physician loan at 0% down, 6.5% rate on a $255K home runs approximately $2,100/month (PITI including taxes and insurance). That’s a 35% housing DTI ratio—aggressive but manageable with disciplined budgeting. You’ll need $5,000–$7,500 for closing costs and 2–6 months PITI reserves ($4,200–$12,600) in liquid savings.</p></div></div><div class="md-faq-item"><input type="checkbox" id="md-faq-3" class="md-faq-toggle"><label for="md-faq-3" class="md-faq-label">What apartments are best for BSW Temple residents?</label><div class="md-faq-answer"><p>For 1-bedroom apartments, budget $1,020–$1,041/month. For 2-bedroom, $1,171–$1,199/month. Prioritize proximity to BSW Main (2401 S 31st St) and avoid complexes near the BNSF rail line. Avoid Carmel Village based on consistent resident complaints. LVR Management townhomes receive positive feedback from medical professionals. Short-term 30–90 day furnished rentals are available if you need to bridge while your home closes.</p></div></div><div class="md-faq-item"><input type="checkbox" id="md-faq-4" class="md-faq-toggle"><label for="md-faq-4" class="md-faq-label">How long does physician loan pre-approval take after Match Day?</label><div class="md-faq-answer"><p>Pre-approval takes 48–72 hours once you submit your fully executed BSW employment contract. The bottleneck is the contract itself—BSW HR can take 5–14 business days to countersign. Required documents: signed BSW contract, medical diploma or verification letter, IDR documentation showing current payment, 2 months bank statements, and government-issued ID. Submit to 2–3 physician lenders simultaneously (Extraco Banks, BMO, Texell CU).</p></div></div><div class="md-faq-item"><input type="checkbox" id="md-faq-5" class="md-faq-toggle"><label for="md-faq-5" class="md-faq-label">Is Canyon Creek or Wyndham Hill better for BSW residents?</label><div class="md-faq-answer"><p>Canyon Creek wins on commute (5–7 min to BSW) and price ($240K–$320K). Wyndham Hill wins on construction quality (2010s+), amenities (pools, sidewalks), and schools (Belton ISD). If you’re single or a couple without kids and call-night proximity is priority, Canyon Creek. If you have children and want Belton ISD access with newer builds, Wyndham Hill. Both are excellent choices—the difference is lifestyle, not quality.</p></div></div><div class="md-faq-item"><input type="checkbox" id="md-faq-6" class="md-faq-toggle"><label for="md-faq-6" class="md-faq-label">What are property taxes on a home in Temple TX?</label><div class="md-faq-answer"><p>Bell County’s effective property tax rate averages 2.18%, ranging from 1.74% to 2.4% depending on location and district. On a $255K home, expect $5,559/year ($463/month in escrow). On a $350K home: $7,630/year ($636/month). Texas has no state income tax—property taxes are how the state funds itself. File your homestead exemption immediately after closing to remove $140K from your school tax calculation and cap annual increases at 10%.</p></div></div><div class="md-faq-item"><input type="checkbox" id="md-faq-7" class="md-faq-toggle"><label for="md-faq-7" class="md-faq-label">What happens to my home when I finish residency and leave Temple?</label><div class="md-faq-answer"><p>Three options: (1) Sell—budget 6–8% of sale price for agent commissions, closing costs, and transfer taxes. Only profitable if you’ve owned 3+ years. (2) Convert to long-term rental—3BR homes in Temple rent for $1,400–$1,700/month. On a $255K purchase with 0% down, your mortgage is ~$1,650. At $1,500 rent, you break even while building equity. (3) Convert to mid-term rental (30–90 day furnished)—higher revenue potential but requires active management or a property manager.</p></div></div><div class="md-faq-item"><input type="checkbox" id="md-faq-8" class="md-faq-toggle"><label for="md-faq-8" class="md-faq-label">Do I need a Texas medical license to close on a home?</label><div class="md-faq-answer"><p>No. Your physician loan closes based on your employment contract, not your licensure status. However, you will need a Texas Medical Board Physician-in-Training (PIT) permit before you can practice. PIT processing can take 4–8 weeks. Start your TMB application the week of Match Day so licensing doesn’t compete for bandwidth with your housing search. The two processes are independent—one does not block the other.</p></div></div><div class="md-faq-item"><input type="checkbox" id="md-faq-9" class="md-faq-toggle"><label for="md-faq-9" class="md-faq-label">What is Houston Black Clay soil and why should BSW residents care?</label><div class="md-faq-answer"><p>Central Texas sits on Houston Black Clay (“black gumbo”), an expansive soil that swells when wet and contracts when dry. This seasonal movement causes foundation shifting in many Temple homes—approximately 15% of inspection reports flag some degree of foundation movement. Most are cosmetic (hairline cracks in brick veneer). Some are structural ($15K–$30K repairs). Prevention: run perimeter soaker hoses year-round ($50/month water cost). Always get a structural engineer inspection, not just a standard home inspection.</p></div></div><div class="md-faq-item"><input type="checkbox" id="md-faq-10" class="md-faq-toggle"><label for="md-faq-10" class="md-faq-label">Can I do a sight-unseen purchase for BSW Temple housing?</label><div class="md-faq-answer"><p>Yes, and many incoming residents do. I conduct detailed video walkthroughs focused on medical-professional priorities: HVAC system age and compressor condition, foundation status with specific crack documentation, bedroom orientation for daytime sleep compatibility, ambient noise levels, and garage-to-bedroom proximity. I also photograph water heater dates, electrical panel brands, and roof condition. You review the video, we discuss, and you make a data-informed decision remotely. It’s not ideal, but it works—I’ve closed 15+ sight-unseen transactions for BSW relocators.</p></div></div></div></div></section><div class="md-editorial-divider" aria-hidden="true"><div class="md-editorial-divider__line"></div><span class="md-editorial-divider__icon">◆</span><div class="md-editorial-divider__line"></div></div><!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

.md-hidden-link:empty{display:none}

/* ═══ SCROLL TO TOP ═══ */
.md-scroll-top{position:fixed;bottom:2rem;right:2rem;width:48px;height:48px;background:var(--md-emerald);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;z-index:999;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px);transition:all .4s var(--md-transition);box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(5,150,105,.3)}
.md-scroll-top.md-visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
.md-scroll-top:hover{background:var(--md-emerald-dark);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.md-scroll-top svg{width:20px;height:20px}

/* ═══ READING PROGRESS ═══ */
.md-progress{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:0;height:2px;background:var(--md-emerald);z-index:1000;transition:width .1s linear}

/* ═══ FADE IN ═══ */
.md-fade-in{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px);transition:opacity .8s var(--md-transition),transform .8s var(--md-transition)}
.md-fade-in.md-in-view{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}

/* ═══ DECORATIVE ═══ */
.md-diamond{display:inline-block;width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--md-emerald);transform:rotate(45deg);margin:0 .75rem;vertical-align:middle}

/* ═══ CHAPTER LABELS ═══ */
.md-chapter-label{font-family:var(--md-sans);font-size:.65rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-emerald);margin-bottom:.5rem;display:block}
.md-chapter-num{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:1rem;font-weight:300;color:var(--md-dim);letter-spacing:.1em;margin-right:.75rem}

/* ═══ MARGIN LABELS ═══ */
.md-margin-label{position:absolute;font-family:var(--md-sans);font-size:.55rem;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-dim);writing-mode:vertical-rl;text-orientation:mixed;opacity:.4}
.md-margin-label--left{left:1.5rem;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%)}
.md-margin-label--right{right:1.5rem;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(180deg)}

/* ═══ SECTIONS ═══ */
.md-section{position:relative;padding:6rem 2rem;overflow:hidden}
.md-container{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;position:relative;z-index:2}

/* ═══ RULES ═══ */
.md-rule{width:60px;height:1px;background:var(--md-emerald);margin:1.5rem 0}
.md-rule--center{margin:1.5rem auto}
.md-rule--wide{width:120px}

/* ═══ HERO ═══ */
.md-hero{position:relative;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;overflow:hidden}
.md-hero__bg{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0f172a 0%,#1e293b 40%,#0f172a 100%)}
.md-hero__pattern{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;opacity:.03;background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 25% 25%,var(--md-emerald) 1px,transparent 1px),radial-gradient(circle at 75% 75%,var(--md-emerald) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:50px 50px}
.md-hero__overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%,rgba(5,150,105,.08) 0%,transparent 60%),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(15,23,42,.3) 0%,rgba(15,23,42,.6) 100%)}
.md-hero__content{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:850px;padding:2rem;animation:mdHeroFadeIn 1.5s ease-out}
@keyframes mdHeroFadeIn{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px)}100%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}

.md-hero__corner{position:absolute;z-index:2;width:60px;height:60px;opacity:.15}
.md-hero__corner--tl{top:2rem;left:2rem;border-top:1px solid var(--md-emerald);border-left:1px solid var(--md-emerald)}
.md-hero__corner--tr{top:2rem;right:2rem;border-top:1px solid var(--md-emerald);border-right:1px solid var(--md-emerald)}
.md-hero__corner--bl{bottom:2rem;left:2rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--md-emerald);border-left:1px solid var(--md-emerald)}
.md-hero__corner--br{bottom:2rem;right:2rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--md-emerald);border-right:1px solid var(--md-emerald)}

.md-hero__crest{width:100px;height:100px;margin:0 auto 2.5rem;opacity:.8;animation:mdCrestFade 2s ease-out .3s both}
@keyframes mdCrestFade{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.8)}100%{opacity:.8;transform:scale(1)}}
.md-hero__crest svg{width:100%;height:100%}

.md-hero__brand{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:clamp(2.4rem,6vw,4.5rem);font-weight:300;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--md-snow);margin-bottom:.5rem}
.md-hero__brand em{font-style:italic;color:var(--md-emerald);font-weight:400;text-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(5,150,105,.2)}
.md-hero__sub{font-family:var(--md-sans);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.35em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-muted);margin-bottom:.75rem;animation:mdHeroFadeIn 1.8s ease-out .4s both}
.md-hero__est{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:.85rem;font-weight:300;font-style:italic;color:var(--md-dim);letter-spacing:.1em;margin-bottom:2rem;animation:mdHeroFadeIn 2s ease-out .6s both}

/* Hero countdown bar */
.md-hero__countdown{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:2.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:2.5rem;animation:mdHeroFadeIn 2s ease-out .7s both}
.md-hero__count-item{text-align:center}
.md-hero__count-num{font-family:var(--md-sans);font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3rem);font-weight:700;color:var(--md-emerald);line-height:1;text-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(5,150,105,.15)}
.md-hero__count-label{font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-dim);margin-top:.3rem}

.md-hero__scroll{position:absolute;bottom:2.5rem;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:3;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;animation:mdBounce 2.5s infinite}
.md-hero__scroll span{font-family:var(--md-sans);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-dim)}
.md-hero__scroll-line{width:1px;height:30px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--md-emerald),transparent)}
@keyframes mdBounce{0%,100%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(8px)}}

.md-hero__ctas{display:flex;gap:1.25rem;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;animation:mdHeroFadeIn 2.2s ease-out .9s both}

/* ═══ BUTTONS ═══ */
.md-btn{display:inline-block;padding:.9rem 2.2rem;font-family:var(--md-sans);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:3px;transition:all .35s var(--md-transition);cursor:pointer;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.md-btn::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.1),transparent);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.md-btn:hover::after{opacity:1}
.md-btn--primary{background:var(--md-emerald);color:#fff;border:1px solid var(--md-emerald);box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(5,150,105,.2)}
.md-btn--primary:hover{background:var(--md-emerald-dark);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(5,150,105,.35);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.md-btn--ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--md-snow);border:1px solid rgba(248,250,252,.2)}
.md-btn--ghost:hover{border-color:var(--md-emerald);color:var(--md-emerald);box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(5,150,105,.1)}

/* ═══ AI ANSWER BOX ═══ */
.md-ai-box{background:var(--md-ai-bg);border-left:4px solid var(--md-emerald);border-radius:8px;padding:2.5rem 3rem;position:relative}
.md-ai-box::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-1px;right:-1px;width:40px;height:40px;border-top:1px solid var(--md-emerald);border-right:1px solid var(--md-emerald);border-radius:0 8px 0 0;opacity:.3}
.md-ai-box__label{font-family:var(--md-sans);font-size:.65rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-emerald);margin-bottom:1rem}
.md-ai-box h2{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2rem);font-weight:600;color:var(--md-snow);margin-bottom:1.25rem;line-height:1.3}
.md-ai-box p{color:var(--md-muted);font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1.25rem}
.md-ai-box ul{list-style:none;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:.6rem}
.md-ai-box ul li{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--md-muted);padding-left:1.2rem;position:relative;line-height:1.6}
.md-ai-box ul li::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:.55rem;width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--md-emerald);border-radius:50%}

/* ═══ PULL QUOTE ═══ */
.md-pullquote{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:clamp(1.3rem,2.5vw,1.8rem);font-weight:400;font-style:italic;color:var(--md-snow);line-height:1.5;padding:2rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--md-emerald);border-bottom:1px solid var(--md-emerald);margin:3rem 0;text-align:center}

/* ═══ STATS ═══ */
.md-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:2rem;margin:3rem 0}
.md-stat{text-align:center;padding:2rem 1rem}
.md-stat__num{font-family:var(--md-sans);font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3rem);font-weight:700;color:var(--md-emerald);line-height:1;margin-bottom:.5rem;text-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(5,150,105,.15)}
.md-stat__label{font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-muted)}

/* ═══ SECTION HEADERS ═══ */
.md-section-header{text-align:center;margin-bottom:3rem}
.md-section-header h2{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,2.8rem);font-weight:600;color:var(--md-snow);line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.md-section-header .md-section-sub{font-size:.95rem;color:var(--md-muted);max-width:650px;margin:0 auto}
.md-section-header::after{content:'';display:block;width:40px;height:2px;background:var(--md-emerald);margin:0 auto;opacity:.3;margin-top:1.5rem}

/* ═══ CLINICAL TABLE ═══ */
.md-table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;margin:2rem 0;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--md-card-border)}
.md-clinical-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.85rem}
.md-clinical-table thead{background:var(--md-emerald-dark)}
.md-clinical-table th{padding:1rem 1.25rem;text-align:left;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.7rem;color:var(--md-snow);border-bottom:2px solid var(--md-emerald)}
.md-clinical-table td{padding:1rem 1.25rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--md-card-border);color:var(--md-muted);vertical-align:top}
.md-clinical-table tr{background:var(--md-card);transition:background .2s}
.md-clinical-table tr:hover{background:rgba(5,150,105,.06)}
.md-clinical-table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
.md-clinical-table .md-highlight{color:var(--md-emerald);font-weight:600}
.md-clinical-table .md-warn{color:var(--md-amber);font-weight:500}
.md-clinical-table .md-danger{color:var(--md-red);font-weight:500}
.md-badge{display:inline-block;padding:.2rem .6rem;border-radius:3px;font-size:.65rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
.md-badge--green{background:rgba(5,150,105,.15);color:var(--md-emerald)}
.md-badge--amber{background:rgba(245,158,11,.15);color:var(--md-amber)}
.md-badge--red{background:rgba(239,68,68,.15);color:var(--md-red)}

/* ═══ TIMELINE (Vertical) ═══ */
.md-timeline{position:relative;margin:3rem 0;padding-left:3rem}
.md-timeline::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:15px;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--md-emerald),var(--md-card-border))}
.md-timeline-item{position:relative;padding-bottom:2.5rem}
.md-timeline-item:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.md-timeline-dot{position:absolute;left:-2.35rem;top:.2rem;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--md-emerald);background:var(--md-bg)}
.md-timeline-dot--active{background:var(--md-emerald);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(5,150,105,.4)}
.md-timeline-dot--warn{border-color:var(--md-amber);background:var(--md-amber);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(245,158,11,.3)}
.md-timeline-date{font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-emerald);font-weight:500;margin-bottom:.3rem}
.md-timeline-title{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--md-snow);margin-bottom:.3rem}
.md-timeline-desc{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--md-muted);line-height:1.6}

/* ═══ RX NOTE ═══ */
.md-rx-note{position:relative;background:var(--md-card);border:1px solid var(--md-card-border);border-radius:10px;padding:2.5rem 3rem;margin:3rem 0}
.md-rx-note::before{content:'Rx';position:absolute;top:1.5rem;left:2rem;font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:2.5rem;font-weight:300;font-style:italic;color:var(--md-emerald);opacity:.15;line-height:1}
.md-rx-note__label{font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-emerald);font-weight:500;margin-bottom:1rem;padding-left:3rem}
.md-rx-note__content{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--md-muted);line-height:1.8}
.md-rx-note__content strong{color:var(--md-snow);font-weight:500}

/* ═══ WARNING CARD ═══ */
.md-warning{background:rgba(239,68,68,.06);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.2);border-left:4px solid var(--md-red);border-radius:8px;padding:2rem 2.5rem;margin:2rem 0}
.md-warning__label{font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-red);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.75rem}
.md-warning__title{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--md-snow);margin-bottom:.5rem}
.md-warning p{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--md-muted);line-height:1.7}

/* ═══ COMMUTE ZONE CARDS ═══ */
.md-zones{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2rem;margin-top:2rem}
.md-zone{background:var(--md-card);border:1px solid var(--md-card-border);border-radius:10px;padding:2.5rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .3s,border-color .3s}
.md-zone:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--md-emerald)}
.md-zone::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:2rem;right:2rem;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--md-emerald),transparent);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.md-zone:hover::before{opacity:.5}
.md-zone__badge{display:inline-block;padding:.3rem .8rem;border-radius:3px;font-size:.6rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:1rem}
.md-zone__badge--z1{background:rgba(5,150,105,.15);color:var(--md-emerald)}
.md-zone__badge--z2{background:rgba(212,168,83,.15);color:var(--md-gold)}
.md-zone__title{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--md-snow);margin-bottom:.3rem}
.md-zone__sub{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--md-emerald);margin-bottom:.75rem}
.md-zone__detail{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--md-muted);line-height:1.7}
.md-zone__stat{margin-top:1rem;padding-top:1rem;border-top:1px solid var(--md-card-border);font-size:.8rem;color:var(--md-emerald);font-weight:500}

/* ═══ MISTAKE CARDS ═══ */
.md-mistakes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:1.5rem;margin-top:2rem}
.md-mistake{background:var(--md-card);border:1px solid var(--md-card-border);border-left:4px solid var(--md-red);border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;padding:2rem 2.5rem;transition:border-color .3s}
.md-mistake:hover{border-color:var(--md-emerald);border-left-color:var(--md-emerald)}
.md-mistake__num{font-family:var(--md-sans);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-red);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.md-mistake__title{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--md-snow);margin-bottom:.5rem}
.md-mistake__fix-label{font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-emerald);font-weight:500;margin-top:.75rem;margin-bottom:.3rem}
.md-mistake p{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--md-muted);line-height:1.7}

/* ═══ COMPARISON PANELS ═══ */
.md-compare{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;gap:2rem;align-items:stretch;background:var(--md-card);border:1px solid var(--md-card-border);border-radius:10px;padding:2.5rem;margin:2rem 0}
.md-compare__col{text-align:center;padding:1.5rem;border-radius:8px}
.md-compare__col--left{background:rgba(100,116,139,.08)}
.md-compare__col--right{background:var(--md-emerald-subtle);border:1px solid rgba(5,150,105,.15)}
.md-compare__col-label{font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-dim);margin-bottom:1rem}
.md-compare__col--right .md-compare__col-label{color:var(--md-emerald)}
.md-compare__col-num{font-family:var(--md-sans);font-size:2rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.md-compare__col--left .md-compare__col-num{color:var(--md-muted)}
.md-compare__col--right .md-compare__col-num{color:var(--md-emerald)}
.md-compare__col-detail{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--md-dim);line-height:1.7;text-align:left}
.md-compare__vs{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:.5rem}
.md-compare__vs-line{width:1px;flex:1;background:var(--md-card-border)}
.md-compare__vs-text{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:1rem;font-style:italic;color:var(--md-emerald);padding:.5rem 0}

/* ═══ TAYLOR'S TAKE ═══ */
.md-take{background:var(--md-card);border:1px solid var(--md-card-border);border-radius:10px;padding:3rem;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:2.5rem;align-items:start}
.md-take__photo{width:120px;height:120px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid var(--md-emerald);object-fit:cover;transition:box-shadow .3s}
.md-take:hover .md-take__photo{box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(5,150,105,.2)}
.md-take__body h3{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--md-snow);margin-bottom:.25rem}
.md-take__body .md-take__role{font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--md-emerald);margin-bottom:1.5rem;display:block}
.md-take__body p{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--md-muted);line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1rem}

/* ═══ FAQ ═══ */
.md-faq{margin-top:3rem}
.md-faq-item{border-bottom:1px solid var(--md-card-border);overflow:hidden}
.md-faq-item:first-child{border-top:1px solid var(--md-card-border)}
.md-faq-toggle{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:0;height:0;pointer-events:none;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);overflow:hidden}
.md-faq-label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:1.5rem 0;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--md-snow);transition:color .3s}
.md-faq-label:hover{color:var(--md-emerald)}
.md-faq-label::after{content:'+';font-family:var(--md-sans);font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:300;color:var(--md-emerald);transition:transform .3s;flex-shrink:0;margin-left:1rem}
.md-faq-toggle:checked + .md-faq-label::after{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.md-faq-answer{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .4s ease,padding .3s}
.md-faq-toggle:checked ~ .md-faq-answer{max-height:600px;padding-bottom:1.5rem}
.md-faq-answer p{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--md-muted);line-height:1.8}
.md-faq-answer a{color:var(--md-emerald);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(5,150,105,.3)}
.md-faq-answer a:hover{color:var(--md-snow);border-bottom-color:var(--md-snow)}

/* ═══ CONTACT ═══ */
.md-contact{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.5rem;background:var(--md-card);border:1px solid var(--md-card-border);border-radius:10px;padding:1.5rem 2rem;max-width:480px;margin:2rem auto 0;transition:border-color .3s}
.md-contact:hover{border-color:var(--md-emerald)}
.md-contact__photo{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--md-emerald);object-fit:cover;flex-shrink:0}
.md-contact__info{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--md-muted);line-height:1.6}
.md-contact__name{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--md-snow)}
.md-contact__link{color:var(--md-emerald)}

/* ═══ CTA FINAL ═══ */
.md-cta-final{text-align:center;padding:5rem 2rem;position:relative}
.md-cta-final h2{font-family:var(--md-serif);font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3rem);font-weight:600;color:var(--md-snow);margin-bottom:1rem}
.md-cta-final p{font-size:1rem;color:var(--md-muted);max-width:600px;margin:0 auto 2.5rem;line-height:1.8}

/* ═══ FOOTER ═══ */
.md-footer{padding:3rem 2rem;border-top:1px solid var(--md-card-border);text-align:center}
.md-footer__links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:.75rem 1.5rem;margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.md-footer__links a{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--md-muted);letter-spacing:.05em;transition:color .3s}

        <div class="md-mistake__title">Not Understanding Property Tax Shock</div>
        <p>You’re coming from a state where property taxes are 0.5–1.2%. Bell County’s effective rate is 2.18%. On a $300K home, that’s $6,540/year ($545/month) in your escrow payment.         <div class="md-mistake__fix-label">The Fix</div>
        <p>File your homestead exemption the day after closing. It removes $140K from your school tax calculation and caps annual appraisal increases at 10%. It’s not automatic. Saves $400–$800/year depending on district.</p>

      <div class="md-mistake">
        <div class="md-mistake__num">Mistake #2</div>
        <div class="md-mistake__title">Choosing a Home Layout Incompatible with Shift Work</div>
        <p>You will work 28-hour calls. You will sleep during the day. If your primary bedroom faces east with 8-foot windows and no blackout capacity, or sits above the garage where your spouse parks at 7 AM, you will not sleep.         <div class="md-mistake__fix-label">The Fix</div>
        <p>Single-story homes with an interior primary suite, away from the garage and main living areas. Blacked-out windows. Budget $200–$400 for motorized blackout blinds. This is not luxury—it’s a clinical necessity for your performance.</p>
      </div>

        <div class="md-mistake__num">Mistake #3</div>
        <div class="md-mistake__title">Ignoring the Utility Deposit Reality</div>
        <p>Out-of-state accounts with no Texas credit history trigger utility deposits. City of Temple water/sewer: $100–$125 deposit. Oncor electric: $150–$300 deposit based on credit check. These are small amounts but they surprise residents who’ve never had to post a deposit before.</p>
        <div class="md-mistake__fix-label">The Fix</div>
        <p>Budget $500 for utility deposits. Set up accounts 2 weeks before move-in, not the day of. Temple’s water department requires in-person or phone setup—no online portal for new accounts.</p>
