Pick the path that matches your role, your commute needs, or your specific question — each card is a deep-dive guide.01By Your RoleWho You AreBSW Match Day to HousingResidents, fellows, PGY-1s — the full timelineIMG Relocation GuideVisa holders + international grads starting at BSWBCM Student & Kiddie Condo GuideMed students and parent-owned housing plays Current Temple TX market conditions for buyersFort Hood + BSW Dual-CareerWhen one of you works the base and one the hospital02By Commute ZoneWhere You'll LiveCanyon Creek5–8 min commute • $250K–$300K • Temple ISDBella Terra5–7 min • $300K–$450K • turn-keyLake Pointe10–15 min • Belton ISD • $280K–$380KPrairie RidgeQuiet, newer build, Academy ISD option03By TopicWhat You Need NextTemple vs Austin for PhysiciansThe actual math on salary, taxes, lifestyleBSW Relocation BenefitsWhat's included — and what you negotiateChildcare & Daycare GuideWaitlists, costs, EAP assistancePet-Friendly HousingHOAs that allow large breeds + rentalsGet Your Personalized Neighborhood MatchTell me your role and I'll send you a custom breakdown of the best neighborhoods for your commute, budget, and timeline.NameEmailWhat's your role at BSW?Select your rolePGY-1/PGY-2 ResidentFellowJunior AttendingSenior AttendingNurse / Allied HealthOtherSend My Neighborhood Match →No spam. Just your personalized match — straight from a local agent who knows every street.Why BSWCost of LivingTimelineNeighborhoodsPhysician LoansSchoolsCommutingMistakesTemple vs AustinFAQContactAI Quick AnswerIs Temple, TX a good place to relocate for Baylor Scott & White?Temple is one of the most cost-effective relocation markets for medical professionals in Texas. BSW Medical Center—Temple is a 640-bed Level I Trauma Center and the flagship teaching hospital for Texas A&M College of Medicine, ranked #7 in Texas by U.S. News (2025). Median home prices sit around $250,000—roughly 40% below the Texas metro average—and most BSW employees live within a 5–15 minute commute of the hospital. Physician mortgage loans are available locally with 0% down and no PMI, and Belton ISD (A-rated) schools serve many of the best neighborhoods despite having a Temple mailing address.Median home price: ~$250,000 (Q1 2026)BSW campus: 640 beds, Level I Trauma, #7 TXClosest neighborhoods: 5–8 min commuteProperty tax rate: 2.2–2.5% (Bell County)Top school district: Belton ISD (A-rated)Physician loans: 0% down, no PMI (Extraco, Regions)Free employee parking (unlike TMC Houston)Cost of living: 15–20% below national averageSources: BSW Health, U.S. News & World Report 2025, Bell County Appraisal District, Niche.com. Verified April 2026.Start HereBaylor Scott & White Relocation ResourcesIf you're moving to Temple for Baylor Scott & White, start here. The pages below break the decision down by the questions BSW employees actually ask: where to live, how far the commute is, what you can afford, how physician loans work, and which neighborhoods fit your role, family, and schedule.Best Neighborhoods Near BSWOverall neighborhood rankings for BSW doctors, nurses, residents, and staff — the canonical neighborhood guide.Neighborhoods by Commute TimeCommute-sorted guide from closest hospital-area options to Belton ISD neighborhoods.BSW Resident Budget CalculatorEstimate buying power by role, salary, debt, and loan type.Resident-to-Attending Housing RoadmapRent-vs-buy and housing strategy from PGY-1 through attending years.IMG Relocation GuideHousing, credit, timeline, and arrival planning for international medical graduates.Physician Mortgage Loan GuideLocal physician loan options, 0% down structures, and contract-based qualification basics.BSW Relocation Benefits GuideHow to think through sign-on bonuses, relocation assistance, and housing timing.Childcare and Daycare GuideDaycare costs, waitlists, and family logistics near BSW Temple.Night Shift Neighborhood GuideQuiet neighborhood picks for nurses, physicians, and staff sleeping during the day.New Construction Near BSWBuilder and neighborhood comparison for new homes within a practical BSW commute.How to Use This HubIf commute matters most — start with the commute guide.If schools matter most — start with the neighborhood guide and the Belton ISD section below.If financing is the question — start with the calculator and physician mortgage guide.If you matched at BSW or are coming in as a resident/fellow — start with the resident roadmap.Want the shortcut? Tell me your BSW role, budget, timeline, and commute tolerance, and I'll send you a practical neighborhood shortlist.Get My BSW Neighborhood Match640Hospital Beds#7Ranked in Texas8 minAvg Commute0%Physician Loan Down40%Below Austin PricesThe HospitalWhy Do Medical Professionals Choose Baylor Scott & White Temple?BSW Temple isn't just another regional hospital — it's the flagship academic medical center for the Baylor Scott & White system and the primary teaching hospital for Texas A&M College of Medicine.Here's what that means for your career:▸640-bed facility with Level I Trauma Center designation (one of only ~20 in Texas)▸Ranked #7 in Texas by U.S. News & World Report (2025)▸High-acuity cases typically reserved for major urban centers — pathology community hospitals transfer out▸Academic environment with resident supervision opportunities▸High Performing ratings in Cardiology, Gastroenterology, and PulmonologyThe clinical exposure rivals Houston's Texas Medical Center or UT Southwestern — but with an 8-minute commute instead of 45.Little GemBecause Temple is a smaller market with fewer sub-specialists, you often see cases a Houston fellow wouldn't touch for three more years. Several BSW residents have told me their case log looked like a PGY-5's by the end of PGY-2.Financial RealityWhat's the Cost of Living Like for BSW Employees?The cost of living in Temple, TX is approximately 15–20% below the national average, with a median home price around $250,000 and average monthly rent of $1,400–$1,700 for a 3-bedroom — making it significantly more affordable than Austin, Dallas, or Houston for BSW employees.A physician salary of $250,000 in Temple provides the lifestyle equivalent of $400,000+ in Austin or Dallas.Property TaxesTexas has no state income tax, but property taxes run 2.2% to 2.5% in Bell County. Here's the real impact:LocationHome ValueAnnual Property TaxTemple (3,000 sq ft executive home)$450,000~$10,000Austin (same home)$900,000~$20,000That's $10,000/year back in your pocket — before you factor in the lower mortgage payment.What Do BSW Employees Actually Earn?▸Physicians (Primary Care): $200,000–$260,000 base▸Specialists: Significantly higher, varies by specialty▸Registered Nurses: ~$71,460 average (Killeen-Temple area)The nursing salary is lower than Houston (~$81k), but the housing cost difference more than makes up for it. Nurses here can actually afford to buy homes.Resident-Specific Housing MathIncoming BSW residents should budget from the PGY-1 stipend, not the attending salary they expect later. The current BSW Temple PGY-1 stipend cited in the resident guide is $70,993 for 2025-2026. That can support a Temple purchase when the payment is controlled, but the dangerous period is March through the first paycheck: inspection money, earnest money, moving costs, and deposits all hit before residency income settles in.▸ Start the lender file the week your BSW contract is available, not after orientation.▸ Rent if the program is short or your cash reserve is thin; buy only when the training length and payment make sense.▸ Compare physician-loan flexibility against builder incentives on the same home, the same day, with real loan estimates.What a BSW nurse's salary actually buys in Temple — a home, a yard, and a short commuteDowntown Temple after a shift — five minutes from the hospital, not forty-fiveWhat Most Agents MissHouston nurses make ~$10K more per year, but Temple nurses buy houses. Factor in the 40% cheaper home, the $10K property tax savings, and the missing mortgage PMI on a physician loan and the "lower salary" becomes a $30K+ net win within 24 months.Your PlaybookYour BSW Relocation TimelineThe 5-phase sequence I walk every BSW client through — from contract signing to "you're a local."90 Days Before StartContract SignedStart physician mortgage pre-approval with local lenders. Get on childcare waitlists immediately. Ask your BSW recruiter about relocation assistance packages.60 Days OutFind Your NeighborhoodVirtual home tours with Taylor. Identify your commute zone. Verify school district zoning (city limits ≠ district boundaries). Narrow to 3–5 properties.30 Days OutClose or Secure LeasePhysician loans can close 60–90 days before your start date using future income underwriting. Set up Temple utilities. If renting first, check temporary housing options.Week 1 in TempleGet SettledBSW orientation. Find your coffee shop (1914 Coffee House is 5 min from the hospital). Drive your commute route during shift change to confirm timing. Meet the neighbors.Month 3You're a LocalBy now you've realized the 8-minute commute changed your life. Weekend trips to Austin are 60 minutes on I-35. You're keeping an extra $10K+/year compared to your Houston or Dallas peers.Offer Letter to HousingHow BSW relocation money should affect your housing planBSW relocation support can lower the cash stress of a move, but it should not make you shop above the payment your base income can support. Treat sign-on and relocation dollars as a reserve, closing-cost tool, or rate-buydown lever after taxes, not as monthly qualifying income.BenefitHousing UseWhat to AvoidSign-on bonusEmergency reserve, closing costs, or rate buydown after tax withholding.Counting the gross bonus as spendable cash.Relocation packageMovers, temporary housing, lease-break help, and area orientation when offered.Using moving money as a larger-home budget.Builder or seller creditCompare the payment impact against a physician loan on the same property.Signing before the lender shows year-1 payment and cash to close.Where to LiveBest Neighborhoods Near Baylor Scott & White TempleThe best neighborhood depends on your call schedule. Here's how I break them down by commute zone.Zone 1: The Medical Core (5–10 Minute Commute)These neighborhoods are packed with residents, fellows, and nurses who prioritize proximity over acreage.5–8 minCanyon CreekMature subdivision, 1990s–2000s construction with established trees. Budget for updates — HVAC, kitchen, bathrooms may need refreshing.PriceMid-$200s–low $300sRouteBack roadsVibeEstablished, mature treesISDTemple ISD5–7 minBella TerraMaster-planned, newer construction, turn-key ready. The community pool has become a social hub for medical families.Price$300K–$450KRouteDown 31st StVibeMaster-planned, move-in readyISDTemple ISD5–10 minHospital District & SurroundsDeerfield Estates: 2,300+ sq ft, $400K–$500K. Butterfly Meadows: custom homes, large windows. Stratford Pl: million-dollar homes at the top of Canyon Creek.Price Range$250K–$1M+ISDTemple ISDHOA & rental restrictions before you buyApartment Living: Villas on the Hill and The Retreat offer flexible lease terms ideal for residents, travel nurses, and anyone not ready to buy. Many offer short-term leases that align with rotation schedules.Also in this range: Prairie Ridge and Hartrick Ranch offer newer construction with Academy ISD at competitive prices.Zone 2: The Executive Belt (10–15 Min)This is where attending physicians with families land. Bigger lots, nicer finishes, and critically — Belton ISD zoning.10–12 minLakewood Ranch / West TempleHalf-acre typical, pools and 3-car garages common. Many homes here are zoned for Belton ISD (specifically Lake Belton High School) despite having a Temple address. Senior medical staff live here.Price$450K–$700K+RouteWest Adams / FM 2305LotHalf-acre typicalISDBelton ISD10–13 minSage MeadowsGreat for someone who wants a lower price point but needs Belton ISD. A smart entry-level pick for nurses and early-career staff.Price$215K–$275KSize1,400–2,100 sq ftLot.15–.33 acISDBelton ISD10–15 minLake PointeNewer construction with strong Belton ISD zoning. Growing area with quick access via West Temple. Solid for families wanting modern builds without the $500K+ price tag.Price$280K–$380KISDBelton ISDCommercial development on West Adams means you're near Chipotle, Fuzzy's Tacos, and Fontana La Riva Italian without driving back toward the hospital.Zone 3: The Lakeside Retreat (15–20+ Min)If you're willing to trade commute time for lifestyle, the lake communities deliver.15–20 minMorgan's Point ResortVacation-like atmosphere, deer roaming, varied topography. The drive is darker and windier at night — surgeons with frequent night calls may find this problematic.Heads up: Morgan's Point has almost no deed restrictions. New house next to a manufactured home is common. If you're sensitive to that, pass.Price$250K–$800K+RouteFM 2483 / Loop 363Best ForLake, boatingISDBelton ISDLuxuryLuxury & Gated OptionsFor high-earning specialists (neurosurgeons, orthopedic surgeons, cardiologists):River Place (Belton): Estate lots along the Leon River, $750K+.Terra Cotta / Cliffs of Canyon Creek: Gated, $500K–$800K, under 10-min commute.Check HOA fees before you buy.BSW Commute Zone Quick ReferenceCommuteNeighborhoodsPrice RangeISDBest For5–10 minCanyon Creek, Bella Terra, Deerfield, Butterfly Meadows$250K–$500KTemple ISDResidents, fellows, nurses10–15 minLakewood Ranch, Sage Meadows, Lake Pointe, West Temple$215K–$700K+Belton ISDAttending MDs with families15–20 minMorgan's Point Resort, River Place$250K–$800K+Belton ISDLake, estate, lifestyleNight-Shift GemQuietest neighborhoods near BSW for night-shift workers: Canyon Creek's interior streets and Bella Terra's cul-de-sacs offer the lowest ambient noise. Avoid homes backing to I-35 or Loop 363. Prairie Ridge is notably quiet with minimal through-traffic.FinancingPhysician Mortgage Loans in Temple, TXPhysician mortgage loans offer 0% down payment and no private mortgage insurance (PMI) for medical professionals. In Temple, Extraco Banks, First Lonestar Bank, Regions, and Truist all serve BSW employees with qualifying MD, DO, DDS, or DPM credentials.How Physician Loans Work▸Zero to 5% down payment (vs. 20% conventional)▸No PMI even with less than 20% equity — saves hundreds/month▸Student loans excluded from DTI (or calculated at IDR amount)▸Future income underwriting: Close 60–90 days before start dateLocal Lenders with Physician Loan ProgramsExtraco Banks0% down • Up to $750KLocal, familiar with BSW contracts. Often closes faster because they understand BSW employment terms.First Lonestar Bank0% down • VariesPersonalized service, regional lender. Good for first-time buyers wanting hands-on guidance.Regions Bank0–5% down • VariesNational option with competitive rates. Solid backup if local lenders can't match your timeline.Truist0–5% down • VariesNational program with broad eligibility. Good for specialists with complex compensation structures.Pro TipLocal lenders like Extraco often close faster because they understand BSW employment contracts. National banks may get hung up on details that local underwriters already know.Future-Income Underwriting for BSW StartsIf you have a signed BSW employment contract, some physician-loan lenders can underwrite against future income before your first paycheck. That matters for incoming residents and fellows because the housing clock starts in March, but the first full paycheck usually arrives after orientation.SchoolsTemple ISD vs. Belton ISD: Which Is Better for Medical Families?Belton ISD consistently earns A-ratings from Niche.com and TEA, with Lake Belton High ranking among the top high schools in Central Texas. Temple ISD offers strong magnet programs and is the more affordable option for homebuyers.District boundaries don't follow city limits. Many of the best "Temple" neighborhoods are zoned for Belton ISD.A-RatedBelton ISD▸Rating: A-rated, consistently top-tier▸Flagship: Lake Belton High (opened 2020)▸Culture: Athletics, college prep focus▸Why medical families choose it: Newer facilities, competitive academicsImprovingTemple ISD▸Rating: Mixed overall, pockets of excellence▸Standout: IB at Temple High, STEM Academy▸Culture: More socioeconomically diverse▸Why some prefer it: IB program is rigorousSmall & StrongAcademy ISD▸Profile: Smaller, rural SE of Temple▸Vibe: "Small town Friday Night Lights"▸Best for: Families buying acreage▸Neighborhoods:Hartrick Ranch (Academy ISD)Always VerifyBefore making an offer on any home, check the address against the Bell County Appraisal District (BellCAD) map to confirm the actual school district. A Temple address can be any of three districts.Commute IntelCommuting and Parking at BSW TempleBSW Medical Center—Temple's main campus is at 2401 S. 31st Street with employee parking lots on the south and east sides. Most Temple neighborhoods offer a 5–15 minute commute with virtually no traffic compared to larger Texas cities.Canyon Creek and the Hospital District are under 7 minutes during shift changes. Free employee parking is available on campus, and the I-35 corridor provides quick access from Belton (15 min) and Salado (20 min). Nurses working 12-hour shifts especially benefit from the short commute times.Traffic Patterns▸I-35 Construction: Major widening ongoing through mid-to-late 2020s. Lane closures frequent.▸Best Strategy: Live west of I-35 and use Loop 363 or back roads. Avoid the construction zone daily.▸Pinch Point: I-35 and Loop 363 intersection, worst 7:30–8:30 AMHospital Parking▸Cost: Free (unlike TMC where you pay hundreds/month)▸Reality: Physician lots fill up. Arrive after 8 AM and you're in outer lots + shuttle.▸Pro tip: Complimentary valet at Brindley Circles and Grobowsky Surgical Center entrancesWatch OutMistakes to Avoid When Relocating to Temple for BSWThe 3 biggest mistakes BSW relocators make: (1) buying a home before visiting Temple in person, (2) skipping the physician mortgage and putting 20% down unnecessarily, and (3) choosing a home in Killeen or Harker Heights without realizing the 30–40 minute commute.1. The "Temple Address" TrapA Temple mailing address doesn't mean Temple schools. Always verify school district zoning before buying.2. The Killeen QuestionYes, housing is cheaper in Killeen (20 minutes west). Avoid it. The commute puts the sun in your eyes both directions, I-14 is congested with military traffic, and the quality-of-life trade-off isn't worth the savings.3. Underestimating Childcare WaitlistsStart the waitlist process the day you sign your contract. Not when you arrive.4. Assuming You Need to Live in TempleSome of the best neighborhoods for BSW employees are technically in Belton or unincorporated Bell County. Don't limit your search to city limits.The ComparisonTemple vs. Houston vs. Austin for Medical ProfessionalsFactorTempleHouston (TMC) / AustinAverage Commute8 minutes45 min / 30–45 minMedian Home Price$275,000$350K / $550KParking CostFree$200+/mo / $150+/moCase AcuityHigh (Level I Trauma)High / ModerateScope of PracticeBroader (fewer specialists)Narrower / ModerateThe bottom line: You see the same pathology in Temple that you'd see in Houston — trauma, complex cancers, rare conditions — but you're one of a few specialists instead of one of hundreds. Career advancement is often faster, and you're not spending 10 hours a week in traffic.Taylor's TakeTaylor DaschReal Estate Investor & Agent • EG Realty • $30M+ in closed real estate volume"I've helped dozens of BSW employees find homes here. The ones who are happiest aren't the ones who bought the biggest house — they're the ones who matched their commute zone to their call schedule."Here's what I tell every BSW employee who calls me: slow down on the house, speed up on the lender. Get your physician mortgage pre-approval started before you even visit Temple. The market moves fast in the $250K–$400K range, and if you're still working with a national lender who doesn't understand a BSW employment contract, you'll lose the home to someone who used Extraco and closed in 21 days.The neighborhoods I recommend most for BSW staff are Bella Terra (if you need proximity and want newer construction), West Temple/Lakewood Ranch (if you have school-age kids and need Belton ISD), and Canyon Creek (if you want the best bang for your buck and don't mind cosmetic updates). For newer construction on a budget, Prairie Ridge and Hartrick Ranch are both worth a serious look.The thing nobody tells you: Temple's real estate market isn't competitive the way Austin or Dallas is. You're not writing letters to sellers or waiving inspections. You have negotiating power here, especially on homes that have been sitting 30+ days. I've gotten closing cost credits, rate buydowns, and appliance upgrades for BSW clients just by asking.One more thing — don't buy in Killeen to save $30K. I've watched three different BSW nurses try that, and all three moved to Temple within 18 months. The commute eats you alive when you're working 12-hour shifts.— Taylor • Text me directly: 254-718-4249FAQWhat Do BSW Employees Ask Most About Relocating to Temple?How far is Baylor Scott & White Temple from Austin?BSW Temple is approximately 60 miles north of Austin, typically a 1-hour drive via I-35. Many staff live in Temple and visit Austin on weekends for concerts, dining, and entertainment. The I-35 widening project may cause delays during construction (through mid-to-late 2020s), so add 15–20 minutes during peak construction periods.What is the best neighborhood for BSW physicians with families?The West Temple / Lakewood Ranch area offers the best balance: 10–12 minute commute, executive homes ($450K–$700K), and Belton ISD school zoning with newer facilities. For a more affordable entry into Belton ISD, Lake Pointe and Sage Meadows are strong alternatives.Can I get a mortgage with high student loan debt?Yes. Physician mortgage loans exclude student debt from DTI calculations and offer 0% down with no PMI. Local lenders like Extraco Banks specialize in these loans for BSW employees. Start pre-approval 90 days before your start date — physician loans allow future income underwriting.Is Temple ISD or Belton ISD better?Belton ISD is generally preferred by medical families for its newer facilities and consistent A-ratings. Temple ISD's IB program at Temple High School is excellent for academically focused students. Always verify which district a home is zoned for — city limits don't match district boundaries. Check BellCAD before making an offer.What's the biggest mistake relocating BSW employees make?Assuming a "Temple" address means Temple schools, or buying in Killeen to save money without understanding the 30–40 minute commute and quality-of-life trade-offs. The second biggest: skipping physician mortgage pre-approval and putting 20% down when you could keep that capital and invest it.Does BSW Temple offer relocation assistance?Yes, BSW Health partners with a dedicated relocation team. Packages vary by role — physicians typically receive the most comprehensive assistance including moving services, temporary housing, and rental search support. Clarify specifics during contract negotiation, not after you've signed.What is the cost of living in Temple compared to Austin?Temple's median home price is $250,000–$300,000, compared to $500,000–$600,000+ in Austin for comparable homes. A physician earning $250,000 in Temple has the lifestyle equivalent of $400,000+ in Austin when you factor in the housing differential, lower property taxes ($10K/year savings on an executive home), and no state income tax.How long is the commute from Temple neighborhoods to BSW?Commute times vary by neighborhood: Canyon Creek and Bella Terra are 5–10 minutes, West Temple/Lakewood Ranch is 10–15 minutes, and Morgan's Point Resort is 15–20 minutes. There is virtually no traffic compared to Austin, Houston, or DFW.What are physician mortgage loans and who offers them in Temple?Physician mortgage loans offer 0–5% down payment with no PMI, and exclude student loans from debt-to-income calculations. In Temple, Extraco Banks (local, up to $750K at 0% down), First Lonestar Bank, Regions Bank, and Truist all offer physician loan programs for qualifying MD, DO, DDS, or DPM credentials.Is parking free at Baylor Scott & White Temple?Yes, parking at BSW Temple is free — unlike Houston's Texas Medical Center where parking can cost $200+ per month. Physician lots fill up after 8 AM, but complimentary valet is available at Brindley Circles and Grobowsky Surgical Center entrances during business hours.Explore MoreEvery Guide in the BSW HubDeep dives into Temple's best neighborhoods, buyer resources, and BSW-specific intelligence.Best Neighborhoods Near BSWNeighborhoods by Commute TimeBSW Resident Budget CalculatorResident-to-Attending Housing RoadmapPhysician Mortgage Loan GuideNight Shift Neighborhood GuideNew Construction Near BSWFort Hood + BSW Dual-Career Commute GuideIMG Relocation Guide for BSW TempleTemple vs Austin for PhysiciansChildcare and Daycare Guide for BSW FamiliesBCM Student Housing and Kiddie Condo GuideBSW Relocation Benefits DecodedPet-Friendly Housing Near BSWBSW Match Day to Housing GuideBella Terra Neighborhood GuideCanyon Creek Neighborhood GuidePrairie Ridge Neighborhood GuideLake Pointe Neighborhood GuideHartrick Ranch Neighborhood GuideLegacy Ranch Neighborhood GuideMoving to Temple TX — Full GuideHOA and Rental Restrictions GuideBrowse All NeighborhoodsTemple vs Waco for medical professionalsReady?Relocating to Temple for BSW? Let's Find Your Neighborhood.Taylor Dasch has helped dozens of BSW medical professionals find homes in Temple and Belton since 2020 — specializing in physician mortgage coordination, remote video tours for out-of-state buyers, and neighborhood matching based on commute time, school district, and budget.Schedule a Call With TaylorCall Now: 254-718-4249Video walkthroughs • School district verification • Physician mortgage lender introductions • Honest advice — including which areas to avoidTaylor Dasch — Real Estate Investor & AgentEG Realty • 254-718-4249 • Email TaylorLast updated: April 16, 2026 • Taylor Dasch | EG Realty | Temple, TX • Specializing in BSW Medical Professional Relocation[/afe]

/* ---------- BASE + VARIABLES ---------- */
/* AGENTFIRE FULL-BLEED BREAKOUT — kills the white sidebar gutters */
.bh-page{
  --midnight:#1e293b;
  --midnight-deep:#0f172a;
  --emerald:#059669;
  --emerald-dark:#047857;
  --emerald-glow:rgba(5,150,105,.25);
  --snow:#f8fafc;
  --light:#e2e8f0;
  --slate:#94a3b8;
  --slate-dark:#64748b;
  --card:#1a2d42;
  --card-2:#142033;
  --border:#2d4a6b;
  --answer:#162032;
  --amber:#f59e0b;
  --amber-soft:rgba(245,158,11,.12);
  color:var(--snow);
  background:var(--midnight-deep);
  font-family:'Outfit',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
  font-size:17px;
  line-height:1.65;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  overflow-x:hidden;

  /* Break out of AgentFire's content wrapper */
  position:relative;
  width:100vw;
  max-width:100vw;
  margin-left:calc(50% - 50vw);
  margin-right:calc(50% - 50vw);
  left:0;
  right:0;
}
/* Belt-and-suspenders: if AgentFire still shows white gutters from a
   grandparent wrapper, this pushes the page's background behind them. */
.bh-page::before{
  content:"";
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  z-index:-1;
  background:var(--midnight-deep);
  pointer-events:none;
}
/* Common AgentFire wrapper classes — neutralize their padding/background */
body .afr-content .bh-page,
body .af-content .bh-page,
body .entry-content .bh-page,
body .page-content .bh-page{
  max-width:none!important;
  padding-left:0!important;
  padding-right:0!important;
}
.bh-page *{box-sizing:border-box}
.bh-page img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;border-radius:10px}
.bh-page h1,.bh-page h2,.bh-page h3,.bh-page h4{
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;
  font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:var(--snow);margin:0 0 .5em
}
.bh-page h1{font-size:clamp(2.4rem,5.2vw,4.2rem);line-height:1.05}
.bh-page h2{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.6vw,2.8rem);line-height:1.15;margin-top:0}
.bh-page h3{font-size:clamp(1.3rem,2.4vw,1.6rem);line-height:1.25}
.bh-page h4{font-size:1.15rem;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.bh-page p{margin:0 0 1.1em;color:var(--light)}
.bh-page a{color:var(--emerald);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:.2s}
.bh-page a:hover{color:#34d399;border-bottom-color:#34d399}
.bh-page strong{color:var(--snow);font-weight:600}

.bh-container{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.bh-narrow{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}

.bh-eyebrow{
  display:inline-block;font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-size:.72rem;
  letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--emerald);
  font-weight:600;margin-bottom:16px;
  padding:6px 14px;border:1px solid var(--emerald);border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(5,150,105,.08)
}

/* ---------- READING PROGRESS ---------- */
.bh-progress{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:3px;background:var(--emerald);width:0;z-index:9999;transition:width .1s}

/* ---------- HERO ---------- */
.bh-hero{
  position:relative;padding:100px 0 60px;overflow:hidden;min-height:72vh;
  display:flex;align-items:center;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0b1628 0%,var(--midnight-deep) 100%);
}
.bh-hero-bg{
  position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;
  background:url('https://assets.agentfire3.com/uploads/sites/2128/2026/02/Temple-TX-BSW-Quiet-Street.jpg') center/cover no-repeat;
  opacity:.22;z-index:0;
  animation:bhSlowZoom 24s ease-out infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes bhSlowZoom{from{transform:scale(1)}to{transform:scale(1.08)}}
.bh-hero::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 0%,rgba(5,150,105,.22),transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 100%,rgba(5,150,105,.12),transparent 50%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(15,23,42,.55) 0%,rgba(15,23,42,.82) 100%);
}
.bh-hero::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;opacity:.06;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(148,163,184,.4) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(148,163,184,.4) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:64px 64px;
}
.bh-hero-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;gap:64px;align-items:center;
  position:relative;z-index:2;width:100%;
}
.bh-hero h1 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:500}
.bh-hero-lead{font-size:1.18rem;color:var(--light);margin-bottom:32px;max-width:580px}
.bh-cta-row{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:28px}
.bh-btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  padding:16px 28px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:600;font-size:.98rem;
  letter-spacing:.01em;transition:.2s;cursor:pointer;border:none;
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;
}
.bh-btn-primary{background:var(--emerald);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 24px var(--emerald-glow)}
.bh-btn-primary:hover{background:var(--emerald-dark);transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 10px 30px var(--emerald-glow);color:#fff;border-bottom:none}
.bh-btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--snow);border:1px solid var(--border)}
.bh-btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--emerald);color:var(--emerald)}

.bh-hero-trust{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--slate);display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.bh-hero-trust span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.bh-hero-trust svg{width:14px;height:14px;fill:var(--emerald)}

/* Hero stat card */
.bh-glance{
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(26,45,66,.9),rgba(20,32,51,.95));
  border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;padding:32px;
  backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
}
.bh-glance-label{
  font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:20px
}
.bh-glance-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.6rem;margin-bottom:18px;color:var(--snow)}
.bh-glance-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.bh-glance-item{padding:14px;background:rgba(15,23,42,.55);border-radius:10px;border:1px solid rgba(45,74,107,.5)}
.bh-glance-item-label{font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:600}
.bh-glance-item-value{font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--snow);letter-spacing:-.01em}

/* ---------- ROUTING HUB (BELOW HERO) ---------- */
.bh-roadmap{
  padding:70px 0 50px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--midnight-deep) 0%,#0a1322 100%);
  border-top:1px solid rgba(45,74,107,.4);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(45,74,107,.4);
  position:relative;
}
.bh-roadmap-head{text-align:center;max-width:780px;margin:0 auto 50px}
.bh-roadmap-head h2{margin-bottom:14px}
.bh-roadmap-head p{color:var(--slate);font-size:1.05rem}

.bh-roadmap-cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:28px}
.bh-roadmap-col{}
.bh-roadmap-col-head{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:18px;
  padding-bottom:14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
.bh-roadmap-col-head .bh-num{
  width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--emerald);
  color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  font-size:1.2rem;display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0;
}
.bh-roadmap-col-head h3{margin:0;font-size:1.35rem}
.bh-roadmap-col-head .bh-sub{display:block;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--emerald);font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-weight:600;margin-top:2px}

.bh-route-card{
  display:block;padding:16px 18px;margin-bottom:10px;
  background:var(--card-2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;
  color:var(--snow);font-weight:500;font-size:.98rem;
  transition:.2s;position:relative;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
.bh-route-card:hover{
  background:var(--card);border-color:var(--emerald);color:var(--snow);
  transform:translateX(4px);border-bottom-color:var(--emerald);
}
.bh-route-card span{display:block;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--slate);font-weight:400;margin-top:3px}
.bh-route-card::after{
  content:"→";position:absolute;right:16px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  color:var(--emerald);font-weight:600;opacity:0;transition:.2s
}
.bh-route-card:hover::after{opacity:1;right:12px}

/* ---------- LEAD FORM ---------- */
.bh-form{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#102338 0%,#18304a 100%);
  border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;padding:40px;
  margin:60px auto;max-width:780px;position:relative;overflow:hidden
}
.bh-form::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:4px;height:100%;background:var(--emerald)
}
.bh-form h2{margin-bottom:8px;font-size:2rem}
.bh-form p{color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:24px}
.bh-form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-bottom:18px}
.bh-form-grid.full{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.bh-form label{display:block;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:600}
.bh-form input,.bh-form select{
  width:100%;padding:14px 16px;background:rgba(15,23,42,.8);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:8px;color:var(--snow);font-size:1rem;font-family:inherit;
}
.bh-form input:focus,.bh-form select:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--emerald);background:rgba(15,23,42,.95)}
.bh-form-small{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--slate);margin-top:12px;text-align:center}

/* ---------- SUB-NAV ---------- */
.bh-subnav{
  position:sticky;top:0;background:rgba(15,23,42,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  z-index:100;padding:14px 0;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch
}
.bh-subnav-inner{display:flex;gap:26px;white-space:nowrap;justify-content:center;min-width:max-content;padding:0 24px}
.bh-subnav a{color:var(--slate);font-size:.88rem;font-weight:500;border-bottom:none;letter-spacing:.01em}
.bh-subnav a:hover{color:var(--emerald)}

/* ---------- AI ANSWER BOX ---------- */
.bh-answer{
  background:var(--answer);border:1px solid var(--border);border-left:4px solid var(--emerald);
  border-radius:12px;padding:32px;margin:50px auto;max-width:960px
}
.bh-answer-tag{
  display:inline-block;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:12px
}
.bh-answer h2{font-size:1.6rem;margin-bottom:14px}
.bh-answer-body{font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--light)}
.bh-answer ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:18px 0 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px 24px}
.bh-answer li{padding-left:18px;position:relative;color:var(--slate);font-size:.9rem}
.bh-answer li::before{content:"▸";position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--emerald)}
.bh-answer-small{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--slate);margin-top:14px;font-style:italic}

/* ---------- STAT STRIP ---------- */
.bh-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:20px;margin:50px 0;padding:32px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.bh-stat{text-align:center}
.bh-stat-num{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--emerald);line-height:1;margin-bottom:6px}
.bh-stat-label{font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);font-weight:600}

/* ---------- SECTION ---------- */
.bh-section{padding:70px 0;position:relative}
.bh-section:nth-child(even){background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(10,19,34,.3))}
.bh-section-head{text-align:center;max-width:820px;margin:0 auto 44px}
.bh-tag{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:12px;display:block}

/* Diamond divider */
.bh-diamond{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:40px 0;color:var(--emerald)}
.bh-diamond::before,.bh-diamond::after{content:"";height:1px;background:var(--border);flex:1;max-width:160px}
.bh-diamond svg{margin:0 16px;width:14px;height:14px;fill:var(--emerald)}

/* ---------- ZONE CARDS ---------- */
.bh-zone-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:20px;margin:32px 0}
.bh-zone{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:26px;transition:.3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.bh-zone:hover{border-color:var(--emerald);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.bh-zone::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:3px;background:var(--emerald);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:.3s}
.bh-zone:hover::before{transform:scaleX(1)}
.bh-zone-time{display:inline-block;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px;padding:4px 10px;background:rgba(5,150,105,.1);border-radius:4px}
.bh-zone h4{margin-bottom:10px;font-size:1.4rem}
.bh-zone p{font-size:.94rem;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:16px}
.bh-zone-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px 16px;font-size:.85rem;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
.bh-zone-meta-label{color:var(--slate);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600}
.bh-zone-meta-val{color:var(--snow);font-weight:500}

/* ---------- TABLES ---------- */
.bh-table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;margin:30px 0;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px}
.bh-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:600px}
.bh-table thead{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#102338,#162032)}
.bh-table th{padding:16px 20px;text-align:left;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.bh-table td{padding:16px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(45,74,107,.4);color:var(--light);font-size:.95rem;vertical-align:top}
.bh-table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
.bh-table tr:hover td{background:rgba(5,150,105,.04)}
.bh-table strong{color:var(--snow)}

/* ---------- LENDER GRID ---------- */
.bh-lender-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:16px;margin:24px 0}
.bh-lender{background:var(--card-2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:20px;border-left:3px solid var(--emerald)}
.bh-lender h5{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.2rem;margin:0 0 4px;color:var(--snow)}
.bh-lender-terms{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:.01em}
.bh-lender p{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--slate);margin:0}

/* ---------- LITTLE GEM / CALLOUT ---------- */
.bh-gem{
  background:var(--amber-soft);border-left:4px solid var(--amber);
  border-radius:8px;padding:20px 24px;margin:26px 0;font-size:.95rem
}
.bh-gem-tag{display:block;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--amber);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px}
.bh-gem p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}

.bh-pro{
  background:rgba(5,150,105,.08);border-left:4px solid var(--emerald);
  border-radius:8px;padding:20px 24px;margin:26px 0
}
.bh-pro-tag{display:block;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px}
.bh-pro p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}

/* ---------- TIMELINE ---------- */
.bh-timeline{position:relative;padding:20px 0;max-width:860px;margin:0 auto}
.bh-timeline::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,var(--emerald) 10%,var(--emerald) 90%,transparent);transform:translateX(-50%)}
.bh-tl-item{position:relative;width:calc(50% - 40px);padding:22px 26px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:30px}
.bh-tl-item:nth-child(odd){margin-left:auto}
.bh-tl-item::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;top:28px;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--emerald);border:4px solid var(--midnight-deep);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--emerald)
}
.bh-tl-item:nth-child(even)::before{right:-50px}
.bh-tl-item:nth-child(odd)::before{left:-50px}
.bh-tl-when{font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px}
.bh-tl-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.3rem;margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--snow)}
.bh-tl-body{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--slate);line-height:1.6;margin:0}

/* ---------- PHOTO PAIR ---------- */
.bh-photo-pair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin:30px 0}
.bh-photo-pair figure{margin:0}
.bh-photo-pair figcaption{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--slate);margin-top:10px;text-align:center;font-style:italic}

/* ---------- TAYLOR'S TAKE ---------- */
.bh-take{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0f1f34 0%,#152744 100%);
  border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;padding:50px;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;max-width:960px;margin:60px auto
}
.bh-take::before{
  content:"\201C";position:absolute;top:-30px;right:30px;font-size:14rem;
  color:rgba(5,150,105,.08);font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;line-height:1
}
.bh-take-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;margin-bottom:28px;position:relative}
.bh-take-head img{width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:2px solid var(--emerald)}
.bh-take-tag{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:2px}
.bh-take-name{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--snow);font-weight:600}
.bh-take-cred{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--slate)}
.bh-take-lede{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1.4;color:var(--snow);margin-bottom:24px;position:relative}
.bh-take p{font-size:1rem;line-height:1.75}
.bh-take-sign{margin-top:24px;padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;color:var(--emerald)}

/* ---------- FAQ ---------- */
.bh-faq{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto}
.bh-faq-item{
  background:var(--card-2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;
  margin-bottom:12px;overflow:hidden;transition:.2s
}
.bh-faq-item:hover{border-color:var(--emerald)}
.bh-faq-input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:0;height:0;pointer-events:none;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);overflow:hidden}
.bh-faq-label{
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;
  padding:20px 24px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:1.04rem;color:var(--snow);
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.2rem
}
.bh-faq-label::after{content:"+";font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--emerald);transition:.2s;flex-shrink:0}

Most Temple neighborhoods offer a 5–15 minute commute with virtually no traffic compared to larger Texas cities.</p><p>Canyon Creek and the Hospital District are under 7 minutes during shift changes. Free employee parking is available on campus, and the I-35 corridor provides quick access from Belton (15 min) and Salado (20 min). Nurses working 12-hour shifts especially benefit from the short commute times.</p><h3>Traffic Patterns</h3><ul style="list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0 0 1.2em"><li style="padding:10px 0 10px 28px;position:relative;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(45,74,107,.3)"><span style="position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700">▸</span><strong>I-35 Construction:</strong> Major widening ongoing through mid-to-late 2020s. Arrive after 8 AM and you're in outer lots + shuttle.</li><li style="padding:10px 0 10px 28px;position:relative"><span style="position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700">▸</span><strong>Pro tip:</strong> Complimentary valet at Brindley Circles and Grobowsky Surgical Center entrances</li></ul></div></section><div class="bh-diamond"><svg viewbox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M8 0L16 8L8 16L0 8L8 0Z"></path></svg></div><!-- ========== MISTAKES ========== --><section class="bh-section" id="mistakes"><div class="bh-narrow bh-fade"><div class="bh-section-head"><span class="bh-tag">Watch Out</span><h2>Mistakes to Avoid When Relocating to Temple for BSW</h2></div><p>The 3 biggest mistakes BSW relocators make: (1) buying a home before visiting Temple in person, (2) skipping the physician mortgage and putting 20% down unnecessarily, and (3) choosing a home in Killeen or Harker Heights without realizing the 30–40 minute commute.</p><h3>1. The "Temple Address" Trap</h3><p>A Temple mailing address doesn't mean Temple schools. <strong>Always verify school district zoning before buying.</strong></p><h3>2. The Killeen Question</h3><p>Yes, housing is cheaper in Killeen (20 minutes west). Avoid it. The commute puts the sun in your eyes both directions, I-14 is congested with military traffic, and the quality-of-life trade-off isn't worth the savings.</p><h3>3. Underestimating Childcare Waitlists</h3><p>Start the waitlist process the day you sign your contract. Not when you arrive.</p><h3>4. Assuming You Need to Live in Temple</h3><p>Some of the best neighborhoods for BSW employees are technically in Belton or unincorporated Bell County. Don't limit your search to city limits.</p></div></section><div class="bh-diamond"><svg viewbox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M8 0L16 8L8 16L0 8L8 0Z"></path></svg></div><!-- ========== COMPARISON ========== --><section class="bh-section" id="compare"><div class="bh-container bh-fade"><div class="bh-section-head"><span class="bh-tag">The Comparison</span><h2>Temple vs. Houston vs. Austin for Medical Professionals</h2></div><div class="bh-compare" style="max-width:960px;margin:0 auto"><div class="bh-row-head">Factor</div><div class="bh-row-head" style="color:var(--emerald)">Temple</div><div class="bh-row-head">Houston (TMC) / Austin</div><div><strong>Average Commute</strong></div><div class="bh-col-temple">8 minutes</div><div>45 min / 30–45 min</div><div><strong>Median Home Price</strong></div><div class="bh-col-temple">$275,000</div><div>$350K / $550K</div><div><strong>Parking Cost</strong></div><div class="bh-col-temple">Free</div><div>$200+/mo / $150+/mo</div><div><strong>Case Acuity</strong></div><div class="bh-col-temple">High (Level I Trauma)</div><div>High / Moderate</div><div><strong>Scope of Practice</strong></div><div class="bh-col-temple">Broader (fewer specialists)</div><div>Narrower / Moderate</div></div><p style="max-width:860px;margin:28px auto 0;text-align:center;font-style:italic;color:var(--slate)"><strong style="color:var(--emerald)">The bottom line:</strong> You see the same pathology in Temple that you'd see in Houston — trauma, complex cancers, rare conditions — but you're one of a few specialists instead of one of hundreds. Career advancement is often faster, and you're not spending 10 hours a week in traffic.</p></div></section><!-- ========== TAYLOR'S TAKE ========== --><section class="bh-section" style="background:none"><div class="bh-container bh-fade"><div class="bh-take"><div class="bh-take-head"><img src="https://assets.agentfire3.com/uploads/sites/2128/2025/11/TaylorDaschImage.jpg" alt="Taylor Dasch, EG Realty"><div><div class="bh-take-tag">Taylor's Take</div><div class="bh-take-name">Taylor Dasch</div><div class="bh-take-cred">Real Estate Investor & Agent • EG Realty • $30M+ in closed real estate volume</div></div></div><p class="bh-take-lede">"I've helped dozens of BSW employees find homes here. The ones who are happiest aren't the ones who bought the biggest house — they're the ones who matched their commute zone to their call schedule."</p><p>Here's what I tell every BSW employee who calls me: <strong>slow down on the house, speed up on the lender.</strong> Get your physician mortgage pre-approval started before you even visit Temple. The market moves fast in the $250K–$400K range, and if you're still working with a national lender who doesn't understand a BSW employment contract, you'll lose the home to someone who used Extraco and closed in 21 days.</p><p>The neighborhoods I recommend most for BSW staff are <a href="https://templetxhomes.net/bella-terra/">Bella Terra</a> (if you need proximity and want newer construction), West Temple/Lakewood Ranch (if you have school-age kids and need Belton ISD), and <a href="https://templetxhomes.net/canyon-creek/">Canyon Creek</a> (if you want the best bang for your buck and don't mind cosmetic updates). For newer construction on a budget, <a href="https://templetxhomes.net/prairie-ridge/">Prairie Ridge</a> and <a href="https://templetxhomes.net/hartrick-ranch/">Hartrick Ranch</a> are both worth a serious look.</p><p>The thing nobody tells you: Temple's real estate market isn't competitive the way Austin or Dallas is. You're not writing letters to sellers or waiving inspections. <strong>You have negotiating power here</strong>, especially on homes that have been sitting 30+ days. I've gotten closing cost credits, rate buydowns, and appliance upgrades for BSW clients just by asking.</p><p>One more thing — don't buy in Killeen to save $30K. I've watched three different BSW nurses try that, and all three moved to Temple within 18 months. The commute eats you alive when you're working 12-hour shifts.</p><p class="bh-take-sign">— Taylor • <a href="tel:2547184249">Text me directly: 254-718-4249</a></p></div></div></section><!-- ========== FAQ ========== --><section class="bh-section" id="faq"><div class="bh-container bh-fade"><div class="bh-section-head"><span class="bh-tag">FAQ</span><h2>What Do BSW Employees Ask Most About Relocating to Temple?</h2></div><div class="bh-faq"><div class="bh-faq-item"><input type="checkbox" id="bhq1" class="bh-faq-input"><label for="bhq1" class="bh-faq-label">How far is Baylor Scott & White Temple from Austin?</label><div class="bh-faq-body"><p>BSW Temple is approximately 60 miles north of Austin, typically a 1-hour drive via I-35. Many staff live in Temple and visit Austin on weekends for concerts, dining, and entertainment. The I-35 widening project may cause delays during construction (through mid-to-late 2020s), so add 15–20 minutes during peak construction periods.</p></div></div><div class="bh-faq-item"><input type="checkbox" id="bhq2" class="bh-faq-input"><label for="bhq2" class="bh-faq-label">What is the best neighborhood for BSW physicians with families?</label><div class="bh-faq-body"><p>The West Temple / Lakewood Ranch area offers the best balance: 10–12 minute commute, executive homes ($450K–$700K), and Belton ISD school zoning with newer facilities. For a more affordable entry into Belton ISD, <a href="https://templetxhomes.net/lake-pointe/">Lake Pointe</a> and Sage Meadows are strong alternatives.</p></div></div><div class="bh-faq-item"><input type="checkbox" id="bhq3" class="bh-faq-input"><label for="bhq3" class="bh-faq-label">Can I get a mortgage with high student loan debt?</label><div class="bh-faq-body"><p>Yes. Physician mortgage loans exclude student debt from DTI calculations and offer 0% down with no PMI. Local lenders like Extraco Banks specialize in these loans for BSW employees. Start pre-approval 90 days before your start date — physician loans allow future income underwriting.</p></div></div><div class="bh-faq-item"><input type="checkbox" id="bhq4" class="bh-faq-input"><label for="bhq4" class="bh-faq-label">Is Temple ISD or Belton ISD better?</label><div class="bh-faq-body"><p>Belton ISD is generally preferred by medical families for its newer facilities and consistent A-ratings. Temple ISD's IB program at Temple High School is excellent for academically focused students. Always verify which district a home is zoned for — city limits don't match district boundaries. Check BellCAD before making an offer.</p></div></div><div class="bh-faq-item"><input type="checkbox" id="bhq5" class="bh-faq-input"><label for="bhq5" class="bh-faq-label">What's the biggest mistake relocating BSW employees make?</label><div class="bh-faq-body"><p>Assuming a "Temple" address means Temple schools, or buying in Killeen to save money without understanding the 30–40 minute commute and quality-of-life trade-offs. The second biggest: skipping physician mortgage pre-approval and putting 20% down when you could keep that capital and invest it.</p></div></div><div class="bh-faq-item"><input type="checkbox" id="bhq6" class="bh-faq-input"><label for="bhq6" class="bh-faq-label">Does BSW Temple offer relocation assistance?</label><div class="bh-faq-body"><p>Yes, BSW Health partners with a dedicated relocation team. Packages vary by role — physicians typically receive the most comprehensive assistance including moving services, temporary housing, and rental search support. Clarify specifics during contract negotiation, not after you've signed.</p></div></div><div class="bh-faq-item"><input type="checkbox" id="bhq7" class="bh-faq-input"><label for="bhq7" class="bh-faq-label">What is the cost of living in Temple compared to Austin?</label><div class="bh-faq-body"><p>Temple's median home price is $250,000–$300,000, compared to $500,000–$600,000+ in Austin for comparable homes. A physician earning $250,000 in Temple has the lifestyle equivalent of $400,000+ in Austin when you factor in the housing differential, lower property taxes ($10K/year savings on an executive home), and no state income tax.</p></div></div><div class="bh-faq-item"><input type="checkbox" id="bhq8" class="bh-faq-input"><label for="bhq8" class="bh-faq-label">How long is the commute from Temple neighborhoods to BSW?</label><div class="bh-faq-body"><p>Commute times vary by neighborhood: <a href="https://templetxhomes.net/canyon-creek/">Canyon Creek</a> and <a href="https://templetxhomes.net/bella-terra/">Bella Terra</a> are 5–10 minutes, West Temple/Lakewood Ranch is 10–15 minutes, and Morgan's Point Resort is 15–20 minutes. There is virtually no traffic compared to Austin, Houston, or DFW.</p></div></div><div class="bh-faq-item"><input type="checkbox" id="bhq9" class="bh-faq-input"><label for="bhq9" class="bh-faq-label">What are physician mortgage loans and who offers them in Temple?</label><div class="bh-faq-body"><p>Physician mortgage loans offer 0–5% down payment with no PMI, and exclude student loans from debt-to-income calculations. In Temple, Extraco Banks (local, up to $750K at 0% down), First Lonestar Bank, Regions Bank, and Truist all offer physician loan programs for qualifying MD, DO, DDS, or DPM credentials.</p></div></div><div class="bh-faq-item"><input type="checkbox" id="bhq10" class="bh-faq-input"><label for="bhq10" class="bh-faq-label">Is parking free at Baylor Scott & White Temple?</label><div class="bh-faq-body"><p>Yes, parking at BSW Temple is free — unlike Houston's Texas Medical Center where parking can cost $200+ per month. Physician lots fill up after 8 AM, but complimentary valet is available at Brindley Circles and Grobowsky Surgical Center entrances during business hours.</p></div></div></div></div></section><!-- .bh-page p{margin:0 0 1.1em;color:var(--light)}
.bh-page a{color:var(--emerald);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:.2s}
.bh-page a:hover{color:#34d399;border-bottom-color:#34d399}
.bh-page strong{color:var(--snow);font-weight:600}

.bh-container{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.bh-narrow{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}

.bh-eyebrow{
  display:inline-block;font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-size:.72rem;
  letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--emerald);
  font-weight:600;margin-bottom:16px;
  padding:6px 14px;border:1px solid var(--emerald);border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(5,150,105,.08)
}

/* ---------- READING PROGRESS ---------- */
.bh-progress{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:3px;background:var(--emerald);width:0;z-index:9999;transition:width .1s}

/* ---------- HERO ---------- */
.bh-hero{
  position:relative;padding:100px 0 60px;overflow:hidden;min-height:72vh;
  display:flex;align-items:center;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0b1628 0%,var(--midnight-deep) 100%);
}
.bh-hero-bg{
  position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;
  background:url('https://assets.agentfire3.com/uploads/sites/2128/2026/02/Temple-TX-BSW-Quiet-Street.jpg') center/cover no-repeat;
  opacity:.22;z-index:0;
  animation:bhSlowZoom 24s ease-out infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes bhSlowZoom{from{transform:scale(1)}to{transform:scale(1.08)}}
.bh-hero::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 0%,rgba(5,150,105,.22),transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 100%,rgba(5,150,105,.12),transparent 50%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(15,23,42,.55) 0%,rgba(15,23,42,.82) 100%);
}
.bh-hero::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;opacity:.06;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(148,163,184,.4) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(148,163,184,.4) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:64px 64px;
}
.bh-hero-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;gap:64px;align-items:center;
  position:relative;z-index:2;width:100%;
}
.bh-hero h1 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:500}
.bh-hero-lead{font-size:1.18rem;color:var(--light);margin-bottom:32px;max-width:580px}
.bh-cta-row{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:28px}
.bh-btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  padding:16px 28px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:600;font-size:.98rem;
  letter-spacing:.01em;transition:.2s;cursor:pointer;border:none;
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;
}
.bh-btn-primary{background:var(--emerald);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 24px var(--emerald-glow)}
.bh-btn-primary:hover{background:var(--emerald-dark);transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 10px 30px var(--emerald-glow);color:#fff;border-bottom:none}
.bh-btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--snow);border:1px solid var(--border)}
.bh-btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--emerald);color:var(--emerald)}

.bh-hero-trust{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--slate);display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.bh-hero-trust span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.bh-hero-trust svg{width:14px;height:14px;fill:var(--emerald)}

/* Hero stat card */
.bh-glance{
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(26,45,66,.9),rgba(20,32,51,.95));
  border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;padding:32px;
  backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
}
.bh-glance-label{
  font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:20px
}
.bh-glance-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.6rem;margin-bottom:18px;color:var(--snow)}
.bh-glance-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.bh-glance-item{padding:14px;background:rgba(15,23,42,.55);border-radius:10px;border:1px solid rgba(45,74,107,.5)}
.bh-glance-item-label{font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:600}
.bh-glance-item-value{font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--snow);letter-spacing:-.01em}

/* ---------- ROUTING HUB (BELOW HERO) ---------- */
.bh-roadmap{
  padding:70px 0 50px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--midnight-deep) 0%,#0a1322 100%);
  border-top:1px solid rgba(45,74,107,.4);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(45,74,107,.4);
  position:relative;
}
.bh-roadmap-head{text-align:center;max-width:780px;margin:0 auto 50px}
.bh-roadmap-head h2{margin-bottom:14px}
.bh-roadmap-head p{color:var(--slate);font-size:1.05rem}

.bh-roadmap-cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:28px}
.bh-roadmap-col{}
.bh-roadmap-col-head{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:18px;
  padding-bottom:14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
.bh-roadmap-col-head .bh-num{
  width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--emerald);
  color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  font-size:1.2rem;display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0;
}
.bh-roadmap-col-head h3{margin:0;font-size:1.35rem}
.bh-roadmap-col-head .bh-sub{display:block;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--emerald);font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-weight:600;margin-top:2px}

.bh-route-card{
  display:block;padding:16px 18px;margin-bottom:10px;
  background:var(--card-2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;
  color:var(--snow);font-weight:500;font-size:.98rem;
  transition:.2s;position:relative;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
.bh-route-card:hover{
  background:var(--card);border-color:var(--emerald);color:var(--snow);
  transform:translateX(4px);border-bottom-color:var(--emerald);
}
.bh-route-card span{display:block;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--slate);font-weight:400;margin-top:3px}
.bh-route-card::after{
  content:"→";position:absolute;right:16px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  color:var(--emerald);font-weight:600;opacity:0;transition:.2s
}
.bh-route-card:hover::after{opacity:1;right:12px}

/* ---------- LEAD FORM ---------- */
.bh-form{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#102338 0%,#18304a 100%);
  border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;padding:40px;
  margin:60px auto;max-width:780px;position:relative;overflow:hidden
}
.bh-form::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:4px;height:100%;background:var(--emerald)
}
.bh-form h2{margin-bottom:8px;font-size:2rem}
.bh-form p{color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:24px}
.bh-form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-bottom:18px}
.bh-form-grid.full{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.bh-form label{display:block;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:600}
.bh-form input,.bh-form select{
  width:100%;padding:14px 16px;background:rgba(15,23,42,.8);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:8px;color:var(--snow);font-size:1rem;font-family:inherit;
}
.bh-form input:focus,.bh-form select:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--emerald);background:rgba(15,23,42,.95)}
.bh-form-small{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--slate);margin-top:12px;text-align:center}

/* ---------- SUB-NAV ---------- */
.bh-subnav{
  position:sticky;top:0;background:rgba(15,23,42,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  z-index:100;padding:14px 0;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch
}
.bh-subnav-inner{display:flex;gap:26px;white-space:nowrap;justify-content:center;min-width:max-content;padding:0 24px}
.bh-subnav a{color:var(--slate);font-size:.88rem;font-weight:500;border-bottom:none;letter-spacing:.01em}
.bh-subnav a:hover{color:var(--emerald)}

/* ---------- AI ANSWER BOX ---------- */
.bh-answer{
  background:var(--answer);border:1px solid var(--border);border-left:4px solid var(--emerald);
  border-radius:12px;padding:32px;margin:50px auto;max-width:960px
}
.bh-answer-tag{
  display:inline-block;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:12px
}
.bh-answer h2{font-size:1.6rem;margin-bottom:14px}
.bh-answer-body{font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--light)}
.bh-answer ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:18px 0 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px 24px}
.bh-answer li{padding-left:18px;position:relative;color:var(--slate);font-size:.9rem}
.bh-answer li::before{content:"▸";position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--emerald)}
.bh-answer-small{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--slate);margin-top:14px;font-style:italic}

/* ---------- STAT STRIP ---------- */
.bh-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:20px;margin:50px 0;padding:32px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.bh-stat{text-align:center}
.bh-stat-num{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--emerald);line-height:1;margin-bottom:6px}
.bh-stat-label{font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);font-weight:600}

/* ---------- SECTION ---------- */
.bh-section{padding:70px 0;position:relative}
.bh-section:nth-child(even){background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(10,19,34,.3))}
.bh-section-head{text-align:center;max-width:820px;margin:0 auto 44px}
.bh-tag{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:12px;display:block}

/* Diamond divider */
.bh-diamond{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:40px 0;color:var(--emerald)}
.bh-diamond::before,.bh-diamond::after{content:"";height:1px;background:var(--border);flex:1;max-width:160px}
.bh-diamond svg{margin:0 16px;width:14px;height:14px;fill:var(--emerald)}

/* ---------- ZONE CARDS ---------- */
.bh-zone-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:20px;margin:32px 0}
.bh-zone{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:26px;transition:.3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.bh-zone:hover{border-color:var(--emerald);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.bh-zone::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:3px;background:var(--emerald);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:.3s}
.bh-zone:hover::before{transform:scaleX(1)}
.bh-zone-time{display:inline-block;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px;padding:4px 10px;background:rgba(5,150,105,.1);border-radius:4px}
.bh-zone h4{margin-bottom:10px;font-size:1.4rem}
.bh-zone p{font-size:.94rem;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:16px}
.bh-zone-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px 16px;font-size:.85rem;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
.bh-zone-meta-label{color:var(--slate);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600}
.bh-zone-meta-val{color:var(--snow);font-weight:500}

/* ---------- TABLES ---------- */
.bh-table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;margin:30px 0;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px}
.bh-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:600px}
.bh-table thead{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#102338,#162032)}
.bh-table th{padding:16px 20px;text-align:left;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.bh-table td{padding:16px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(45,74,107,.4);color:var(--light);font-size:.95rem;vertical-align:top}
.bh-table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
.bh-table tr:hover td{background:rgba(5,150,105,.04)}
.bh-table strong{color:var(--snow)}

/* ---------- LENDER GRID ---------- */
.bh-lender-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:16px;margin:24px 0}
.bh-lender{background:var(--card-2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:20px;border-left:3px solid var(--emerald)}
.bh-lender h5{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.2rem;margin:0 0 4px;color:var(--snow)}
.bh-lender-terms{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:.01em}
.bh-lender p{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--slate);margin:0}

/* ---------- LITTLE GEM / CALLOUT ---------- */
.bh-gem{
  background:var(--amber-soft);border-left:4px solid var(--amber);
  border-radius:8px;padding:20px 24px;margin:26px 0;font-size:.95rem
}
.bh-gem-tag{display:block;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--amber);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px}
.bh-gem p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}

.bh-pro{
  background:rgba(5,150,105,.08);border-left:4px solid var(--emerald);
  border-radius:8px;padding:20px 24px;margin:26px 0
}
.bh-pro-tag{display:block;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px}
.bh-pro p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}

/* ---------- TIMELINE ---------- */
.bh-timeline{position:relative;padding:20px 0;max-width:860px;margin:0 auto}
.bh-timeline::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,var(--emerald) 10%,var(--emerald) 90%,transparent);transform:translateX(-50%)}
.bh-tl-item{position:relative;width:calc(50% - 40px);padding:22px 26px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:30px}
.bh-tl-item:nth-child(odd){margin-left:auto}
.bh-tl-item::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;top:28px;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--emerald);border:4px solid var(--midnight-deep);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--emerald)
}
.bh-tl-item:nth-child(even)::before{right:-50px}
.bh-tl-item:nth-child(odd)::before{left:-50px}
.bh-tl-when{font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px}
.bh-tl-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.3rem;margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--snow)}
.bh-tl-body{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--slate);line-height:1.6;margin:0}

/* ---------- PHOTO PAIR ---------- */
.bh-photo-pair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin:30px 0}
.bh-photo-pair figure{margin:0}
.bh-photo-pair figcaption{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--slate);margin-top:10px;text-align:center;font-style:italic}

/* ---------- TAYLOR'S TAKE ---------- */
.bh-take{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0f1f34 0%,#152744 100%);
  border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;padding:50px;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;max-width:960px;margin:60px auto
}
.bh-take::before{
  content:"\201C";position:absolute;top:-30px;right:30px;font-size:14rem;
  color:rgba(5,150,105,.08);font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;line-height:1
}
.bh-take-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;margin-bottom:28px;position:relative}
.bh-take-head img{width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:2px solid var(--emerald)}
.bh-take-tag{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:2px}
.bh-take-name{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--snow);font-weight:600}
.bh-take-cred{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--slate)}
.bh-take-lede{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1.4;color:var(--snow);margin-bottom:24px;position:relative}
.bh-take p{font-size:1rem;line-height:1.75}
.bh-take-sign{margin-top:24px;padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;color:var(--emerald)}

/* ---------- FAQ ---------- */
.bh-faq{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto}
.bh-faq-item{
  background:var(--card-2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;
  margin-bottom:12px;overflow:hidden;transition:.2s
}
.bh-faq-item:hover{border-color:var(--emerald)}
.bh-faq-input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:0;height:0;pointer-events:none;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);overflow:hidden}
.bh-faq-label{
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;
  padding:20px 24px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:1.04rem;color:var(--snow);
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.2rem
}
.bh-faq-label::after{content:"+";font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--emerald);transition:.2s;flex-shrink:0}
.bh-faq-input:checked+.bh-faq-label::after{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.bh-faq-body{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .3s ease;padding:0 24px}
.bh-faq-input:checked~.bh-faq-body{max-height:600px;padding:0 24px 24px}
.bh-faq-body p{margin:0;color:var(--light);font-size:.96rem;line-height:1.7}

/* ---------- EXPLORE GRID (Routing block final) ---------- */
.bh-explore{padding:70px 0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0a1322 0%,var(--midnight-deep) 100%)}
.bh-explore-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:14px;margin:30px 0
}
.bh-explore-link{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;
  padding:18px 22px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:10px;color:var(--snow);font-weight:500;font-size:.98rem;
  transition:.2s;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)
}
.bh-explore-link:hover{background:var(--card-2);border-color:var(--emerald);color:var(--snow);transform:translateY(-2px);border-bottom-color:var(--emerald)}
.bh-explore-link::after{content:"→";color:var(--emerald);opacity:0;transition:.2s}
.bh-explore-link:hover::after{opacity:1}

/* ---------- COMPARISON CARD (vs Austin/Houston) ---------- */
.bh-compare{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr;gap:0;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;margin:30px 0}
.bh-compare>div{padding:16px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(45,74,107,.4);border-right:1px solid rgba(45,74,107,.4)}
.bh-compare>div:nth-child(3n){border-right:none}
.bh-compare>div:nth-last-child(-n+3){border-bottom:none}
.bh-compare .bh-row-head{background:rgba(5,150,105,.08);color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase}
.bh-compare .bh-col-temple{background:rgba(5,150,105,.04);color:var(--snow);font-weight:600}

/* ---------- FINAL CTA ---------- */
.bh-final{
  padding:90px 0;text-align:center;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%,rgba(5,150,105,.15),transparent 50%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,var(--midnight-deep) 0%,#0a1322 100%);
}
.bh-final h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,4.5vw,3.4rem);max-width:900px;margin:0 auto 18px}
.bh-final p{max-width:720px;margin:0 auto 30px;color:var(--light);font-size:1.08rem}
.bh-final-sig{margin:40px auto 0;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:20px 28px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;text-align:left}
.bh-final-sig img{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:2px solid var(--emerald)}
.bh-final-sig-name{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--snow);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:2px}
.bh-final-sig-sub{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--slate)}

/* ---------- FADE-INS ---------- */
.bh-fade{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}
.bh-fade.bh-in{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}

/* ---------- RESPONSIVE ---------- */
@media (max-width:960px){
  .bh-hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px}
  .bh-glance{max-width:560px}
  .bh-roadmap-cols{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px}
  .bh-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .bh-answer ul{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .bh-timeline::before{left:22px}
  .bh-tl-item{width:calc(100% - 60px);margin-left:60px!important}
  .bh-tl-item::before{left:-50px!important;right:auto!important}
  .bh-compare{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0}
  .bh-compare>div{border-right:none!important}
  .bh-photo-pair{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .bh-page{font-size:16px}

    <div class="bh-section-head">
      <span class="bh-tag">The Hospital</span>
      <h2>Why Do Medical Professionals Choose Baylor Scott & White Temple?</h2>
    </div>
    <p>BSW Temple isn't just another regional hospital — it's the <strong>flagship academic medical center</strong> for the Baylor Scott & White system and the primary teaching hospital for Texas A&M College of Medicine.</p>
    <p>Here's what that means for your career:</p>
    <ul style="list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0 0 1.4em">
      <li style="padding:10px 0 10px 28px;position:relative;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(45,74,107,.3)"><span style="position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700">▸</span> <strong>640-bed facility</strong> with Level I Trauma Center designation (one of only ~20 in Texas)</li>
      <li style="padding:10px 0 10px 28px;position:relative;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(45,74,107,.3)"><span style="position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700">▸</span> <strong>Ranked #7 in Texas</strong> by U.S. News & World Report (2025)</li>
      <li style="padding:10px 0 10px 28px;position:relative;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(45,74,107,.3)"><span style="position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700">▸</span> <strong>High-acuity cases</strong> typically reserved for major urban centers — pathology community hospitals transfer out</li>
      <li style="padding:10px 0 10px 28px;position:relative;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(45,74,107,.3)"><span style="position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700">▸</span> <strong>Academic environment</strong> with resident supervision opportunities</li>
      <li style="padding:10px 0 10px 28px;position:relative"><span style="position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:700">▸</span> <strong>High Performing</strong> ratings in Cardiology, Gastroenterology, and Pulmonology</li>
    </ul>

      <h2>Commuting and Parking at BSW Temple</h2>
    </div>
    <p>BSW Medical Center—Temple's main campus is at <strong>2401 S. 31st Street</strong> with employee parking lots on the south and east sides. Most Temple neighborhoods offer a 5–15 minute commute with virtually no traffic compared to larger Texas cities.</p>
    <p>Canyon Creek and the Hospital District are under 7 minutes during shift changes. Free employee parking is available on campus, and the I-35 corridor provides quick access from Belton (15 min) and Salado (20 min). Nurses working 12-hour shifts especially benefit from the short commute times.</p>
