content.raw: [afe element_id="spark_page"]Home/BSW Relocation/ Best Neighborhoods Near BSW Updated April 2026Best Neighborhoods Near Baylor Scott & White Temple TXCommute times, price ranges, school districts, and honest tradeoffs — ranked by a local agent who was a paramedic driving to BSW from every direction before getting into real estate.Get My BSW Relocation GuideSearch Homes Near BSWExploreThe Short AnswerWhere Should BSW Employees Live?Most Baylor Scott & White employees in Temple end up in West Temple. The reason is practical: you get Belton ISD schools, a 5–12 minute commute, and newer construction — all without leaving the Temple city limits. Your mailing address says Temple, your property taxes go to Temple, but your kids attend Belton ISD schools. That paradox drives property values in West Temple above the city median. For physicians arriving on a July 1 start date, the smartest move is starting your pre-approval 90 days out — because every other incoming resident is doing the same thing, and the inventory crunch is real.AI Answer SummaryWhat are the best neighborhoods near Baylor Scott & White in Temple TX?The best neighborhoods near BSW Temple depend on your commute tolerance and career stage. Under 10 minutes: Canyon Creek ($140K–$500K+, Temple ISD), Bella Terra ($300K–$350K), and The District ($150K–$250K, walkable). 10–15 minutes: Sage Meadows ($270K–$325K, Belton ISD), Hills of Westwood ($315K–$415K+), Groves at Lakewood Ranch ($350K–$500K+). 15–20 minutes: Three Creeks ($280K–$400K, new construction), Dawson Ranch ($400K–$750K+). Most BSW employees end up in West Temple — you live in Temple but your kids go to Belton ISD schools. That’s the most sought-after combination in Bell County.Canyon Creek — $140K–$500K+, 5–7 min, Temple ISDSage Meadows — $270K–$325K, Belton ISDHills of Westwood — $315K–$415K+, Belton ISDThree Creeks — $280K–$400K, new constructionThe District — $150K–$250K, walkable to BSWDawson Ranch — $400K–$750K+, half-acre lots8,884Employees at BSW Temple Campus$255KMedian Home Price (vs $525K Austin)31Residency Programs13–17%Below National Cost of LivingThe InstitutionBSW Temple at a GlanceBaylor Scott & White Medical Center – Temple is a 636-bed Level I Trauma Center and the flagship campus of the largest not-for-profit health system in Texas. Ranked #7 in Texas by U.S. News & World Report, BSW Temple is also a teaching hospital for the Texas A&M Health Science Center, with 300+ medical students rotating at any given time across 31 residency programs.Combined with the adjacent VA medical center, the medical corridor employs 12,000+ people — roughly 20% of Temple’s entire workforce. A 45-bed rehabilitation hospital opened in January 2026, further expanding the campus footprint. This concentration of medical employment is why housing demand near BSW stays structurally high regardless of broader market cycles. When 20% of your city works at one campus, that campus dictates real estate patterns.Chapter I — Zone 1Under 10 Minutes from BSWThese neighborhoods put you within a single traffic light cycle of the hospital. For surgical staff on trauma call, physicians pulling overnight shifts, and anyone who values the shortest possible commute, Zone 1 is where you start looking.The District / TMED$150K–$250KWalkable to BSWUnder 5 MinTemple ISDHousing1950s bungalows, renovated flips, duplexesHOANoneCommuteUnder 5 minutes — walkableNearest Coffee1914 Coffee House (across 31st from hospital)The closest you can live to BSW without sleeping in the call room. A mix of original 1950s bungalows, recently renovated flips, and a handful of duplexes that medical students have been renting for decades. The walkability factor is the draw — 1914 Coffee House is literally across 31st Street from the hospital campus.Best for: Medical students, single residents, physician-investors looking for a duplex play.Little Gem — Dual-Use Physician Loan PlayBuy a duplex in The District with a physician loan (zero down, no PMI). Live in one side during residency, rent the other side to a fellow resident or med student — near-guaranteed occupancy. When you finish residency and move to a bigger house, convert both sides to rental. You just built a cash-flowing asset with no money down during the lowest-income years of your medical career.Canyon Creek$140K–$500K+5–7 MinTemple ISDHOA $30–$45/moCimarron$140K–$175K (entry point)Mid Canyon Creek$225K–$275KCliffs at Canyon Creek$400K–$500KStrata$1M+ (luxury)The widest price range of any single neighborhood in Temple. Modern brick-on-slab construction, mature trees, parks, and a quick straight shot east on Adams Avenue to BSW. This is the default recommendation for BSW employees who want to stay in Temple ISD.Best for: All BSW employees — the price range covers every career stage.Short-term rentals require a Special Use Permit in Temple. Don’t plan on Airbnb-ing your Canyon Creek home without going through the permitting process first.Full Canyon Creek neighborhood guide →Bella Terra$300K–$350K5–8 MinTemple ISDHOA $40–$50/moBuilderCarothersAmenitiesBasketball court, park areaConstruction2015+ builds, brick, slab-on-gradeCommute5–8 minutes to BSWTight price band and a single builder keep Bella Terra consistent. Every home was built by Carothers, so you know what you’re getting — good quality brick construction without the wild variation you see in larger subdivisions. The neighborhood is compact, quiet, and popular with young attending physicians and dual-income professional couples who want something newer without a long commute.Best for: Young professionals, early attendings, dual-income couples without kids.Full Bella Terra neighborhood guide →Legacy Ranch$450K–$700K7–10 MinTemple ISDHOA ~$46/moMaster-planned community with larger lots and premium finishes. Legacy Ranch is where established BSW physicians land when they want to stay in Temple ISD but want the lot size and build quality that approaches luxury territory. Close enough to BSW for a quick commute, far enough west to feel like you have breathing room.Best for: Established attendings, families who want premium homes in Temple ISD.Full Legacy Ranch neighborhood guide →Hospital District / South Odd Streets$140K–$185K3–4 MinTemple ISDInspection RequiredHousing1950s pier and beamHOA$0 — noneRental RestrictionsNoneCommute3–4 minutes to BSWThe absolute closest neighborhood to BSW Temple. These are 1950s pier-and-beam homes — no HOA, no rental restrictions, and the lowest prices you will find within walking distance of a Level I Trauma Center. The tradeoff is clear: these are old homes that require a thorough inspection. Foundation, plumbing, and electrical are the three things that will cost you if you skip due diligence.Best for: Night shift workers, first-time buyers, investors.Pier-and-beam foundation homes in this area require careful inspection. Budget $5K–$15K for potential foundation, plumbing, or electrical repairs on any home built before 1960.Chapter II — Zone 210–15 Minutes from BSWThis is the sweet spot for most BSW families. The majority of BSW physicians, nurses, and staff settle in this zone.Little Gem — The West Temple ParadoxCity limits and school district boundaries do not match in Central Texas. A home with a Temple mailing address is often zoned for Belton ISD. Most BSW employees end up in “West Temple” — their address says Temple, their property taxes go to Temple, but their kids attend Belton ISD schools. This overlap is the most sought-after combination in Bell County, and it’s the primary reason West Temple property values outperform the rest of the city.Sage Meadows$270K–$325K5–10 MinBelton ISDHOA $190–$210/yrPrice/sqft~$130–$140/sqftSchoolsPirtle Elementary, Lake Belton Middle, Lake Belton HighConstructionBrick single-family, 2018+HOA$190–$210/year (low)The most popular neighborhood for incoming BSW residents and fellows. Brick single-family homes, clean streets, and a commute that rarely hits double digits.Best for: Residents, fellows, young attendings, nurses.Hills of Westwood$315K–$415K+8–12 MinBelton ISDCommunity PoolBuildersOmega, KiellaMaster HOA~$180/yearEnclave (gated)~$125/monthNearbyH-E-B, Target, gyms, Summer Moon CoffeeThe unofficial “BSW physician neighborhood.” Hills of Westwood has two tiers: the main subdivision with an annual HOA (~$180/year), and the Enclave — a gated section with a monthly HOA (~$125/month) and higher-end builds. Community pool, playground, and you’re a 3-minute drive from H-E-B, Target, Summer Moon Coffee, and multiple gyms. This is where the money lands for established attendings and specialists.Best for: Established attendings, specialists, dual-physician households.Mesa Ridge$280K–$350K10–12 MinBelton ISDHOA $21/moSolid mid-range option in the Belton ISD corridor. HOA is managed by Accent Real Estate at $21/month — low enough to be forgettable, high enough to maintain common areas. A practical choice for BSW families who want Belton ISD without stretching into the $400K+ range.Best for: Families, mid-career BSW staff.Groves at Lakewood Ranch$350K–$500K+12–15 MinBelton ISDLake Belton AccessSize2,000–3,000 sqftFinishesGranite, custom cabinetry, upgradedSchoolsLakewood Elementary (Belton ISD)AmenitiesCommunity pool, parks, Lake Belton accessThe premium option in Zone 2. Lakewood Ranch homes are 2,000–3,000 sqft with granite countertops, custom cabinetry, and finishes that justify the price tag. Feeds into Lakewood Elementary, one of Belton ISD’s newer campuses. Community pool, parks, and proximity to Lake Belton for weekend recreation. This is where department heads, senior specialists, cardiologists, gastroenterologists, and CRNAs land.Best for: Department heads, senior specialists, CRNAs.Chapter III — Zone 315–20 Minutes from BSWYou are trading commute time for space, newer construction, and a more rural feel. The surgeons and specialists who want half-acre lots with mature oaks and Belton charm live in this zone. The key routing trick: FM 1670 bypasses I-35 entirely.Three Creeks$280K–$400K15–18 Min via FM 1670Belton ISDNew ConstructionBuildersStylecraft, D.R. Horton, Carothers ExecutiveHOA~$120/quarter ($480/year); transfer $360AmenitiesPrivate pavilions, Lampasas River, hiking, sand volleyballCommute TipFM 1670 avoids I-35 entirelyThree Creeks feels like a different world from West Temple. Lampasas River access, hiking trails, private pavilions, and sand volleyball courts — all within a master-planned community that has three active builders competing for your business. The 15–18 minute commute sounds long until you realize FM 1670 avoids I-35 entirely, so it’s a straight two-lane drive with zero highway stress. Belton ISD, new construction, and outdoor lifestyle at a price point that undercuts Hills of Westwood by $50K–$100K.Best for: Active families, outdoor enthusiasts, new construction buyers.Dawson Ranch$400K–$750K+15–20 MinBelton ISDHalf-Acre+ LotsLot SizeHalf-acre+ with mature oaksHOA~$180/yearSub-sectionRegatta Oaks (garden homes for empty nesters)Premium forSpace, privacy, acreageIf you want the largest lots in the Belton ISD corridor, this is where they are. Half-acre-plus homesites with mature oaks, $180/year HOA, and prices that reflect the space. Regatta Oaks is a sub-section with smaller garden homes designed for empty nesters — surgeons whose kids have left but who don’t want to leave the Belton area. This is the “forever home” neighborhood for senior BSW physicians who are done moving.Best for: Department heads, senior specialists, CRNAs, surgeons.Highland Estates$350K–$550K15–20 MinTemple ISDNear Belton LakeHOA$14–$20/monthLotsNice lots, mature treesNoteLease copy required within 5 daysLifestyleNear Belton Lake for recreationGood lots with mature trees and proximity to Belton Lake. Highland Estates lands in Temple ISD rather than Belton ISD, so factor that into your decision. The HOA is modest ($14–$20/month) but has a rule worth knowing: if you rent your home, you must provide a copy of the lease within 5 days. Solid option for BSW staff who prioritize outdoor recreation and larger lots over school district optimization.Best for: Lifestyle buyers, Lake Belton recreation, those fine with Temple ISD.Chapter IV — Zone 420+ Minutes from BSWBeyond 20 minutes, you are making a deliberate lifestyle trade. These locations serve BSW staff who have specific reasons — military spouse stationed at Fort Hood, lake lifestyle commitment, or simply a willingness to commute for more house per dollar. They work. But verify your specific commute during rush hour before signing.Harker Heights$350K–$500K15–20 Min via Hwy 190/I-14Killeen ISDThe Ridge • Country TrailsHarker Heights makes sense for one specific household: dual-career military/medical. That’s the most sought-after combination in Bell County.</p><ul class="bsw-ai-box__list"><li><strong>Canyon Creek</strong> — $140K–$500K+, 5–7 min, Temple ISD</li><li><strong>Sage Meadows</strong> — $270K–$325K, Belton ISD</li><li><strong>Hills of Westwood</strong> — $315K–$415K+, Belton ISD</li><li><strong>Three Creeks</strong> — $280K–$400K, new construction</li><li><strong>The District</strong> — $150K–$250K, walkable to BSW</li><li><strong>Dawson Ranch</strong> — $400K–$750K+, half-acre lots</li></ul></div></div></section><!-- Section Accent --><div class="bsw-section-accent" aria-hidden="true"></div><!-- ========== STAT STRIP ========== --><section class="bsw-section--alt bsw-section" aria-label="BSW Temple Key Statistics"><div class="bsw-container"><div class="bsw-stat-strip bsw-fade-in"><div class="bsw-stat-strip__item"><div class="bsw-stat-strip__number">8,884</div><div class="bsw-stat-strip__desc">Employees at BSW Temple Campus</div></div><div class="bsw-stat-strip__item"><div class="bsw-stat-strip__number">$255K</div><div class="bsw-stat-strip__desc">Median Home Price (vs $525K Austin)</div></div><div class="bsw-stat-strip__item"><div class="bsw-stat-strip__number">31</div><div class="bsw-stat-strip__desc">Residency Programs</div></div><div class="bsw-stat-strip__item"><div class="bsw-stat-strip__number">13–17%</div><div class="bsw-stat-strip__desc">Below National Cost of Living</div></div></div></div></section><!-- ========== BSW AT A GLANCE ========== --><section class="bsw-section bsw-glow" aria-labelledby="bsw-glance-heading"><div class="bsw-container"><div class="bsw-fade-in"><span class="bsw-chapter">The Institution</span><h2 class="bsw-h2" id="bsw-glance-heading">BSW Temple at a Glance</h2><p class="bsw-body">Baylor Scott & White Medical Center – Temple is a 636-bed Level I Trauma Center and the flagship campus of the largest not-for-profit health system in Texas. Ranked #7 in Texas by U.S. News & World Report, BSW Temple is also a teaching hospital for the Texas A&M Health Science Center, with 300+ medical students rotating at any given time across 31 residency programs.</p><p class="bsw-body">Combined with the adjacent VA medical center, the medical corridor employs 12,000+ people — roughly 20% of Temple’s entire workforce. A 45-bed rehabilitation hospital opened in January 2026, further expanding the campus footprint. This concentration of medical employment is why housing demand near BSW stays structurally high regardless of broader market cycles. When 20% of your city works at one campus, that campus dictates real estate patterns.</p></div></div></section><!-- Diamond Divider --><div class="bsw-diamond-divider" aria-hidden="true"><div class="bsw-diamond-divider__line"></div><div class="bsw-diamond"></div><div class="bsw-diamond-divider__line"></div></div><!-- ========== ZONE 1: UNDER 10 MINUTES ========== --><section class="bsw-section" aria-labelledby="bsw-zone1-heading"><div class="bsw-container"><div class="bsw-fade-in"><span class="bsw-chapter">Chapter I — Zone 1</span><h2 class="bsw-h2" id="bsw-zone1-heading">Under 10 Minutes from BSW</h2><p class="bsw-body">These neighborhoods put you within a single traffic light cycle of the hospital. For surgical staff on trauma call, physicians pulling overnight shifts, and anyone who values the shortest possible commute, Zone 1 is where you start looking.</p></div><img src="https://assets.agentfire3.com/uploads/sites/2128/2026/03/close-neighborhood.png" alt="Neighborhoods close to BSW Temple" class="bsw-zone-img bsw-fade-in" width="1140" height="280" loading="lazy"><!-- The District / TMED --><div class="bsw-card bsw-fade-in"><div class="bsw-card__header"><h3 class="bsw-h3">The District / TMED</h3><span class="bsw-card__price">$150K–$250K</span></div><div class="bsw-card__tags"><span class="bsw-tag--emerald bsw-tag">Walkable to BSW</span><span class="bsw-tag--emerald bsw-tag">Under 5 Min</span><span class="bsw-tag">Temple ISD</span></div><dl class="bsw-card__grid"><dt>Housing</dt><dd>1950s bungalows, renovated flips, duplexes</dd><dt>HOA</dt><dd>None</dd><dt>Commute</dt><dd>Under 5 minutes — walkable</dd><dt>Nearest Coffee</dt><dd>1914 Coffee House (across 31st from hospital)</dd></dl><p class="bsw-body" style="margin-top:12px;">The closest you can live to BSW without sleeping in the call room. A mix of original 1950s bungalows, recently renovated flips, and a handful of duplexes that medical students have been renting for decades. The walkability factor is the draw — 1914 Coffee House is literally across 31st Street from the hospital campus.</p><p class="bsw-body"><strong>Best for:</strong> Medical students, single residents, physician-investors looking for a duplex play.</p><div class="bsw-gem-box"><div class="bsw-gem-box__title">Little Gem — Dual-Use Physician Loan Play</div><p class="bsw-gem-box__body">Buy a duplex in The District with a physician loan (zero down, no PMI). Live in one side during residency, rent the other side to a fellow resident or med student — near-guaranteed occupancy. When you finish residency and move to a bigger house, convert both sides to rental. You just built a cash-flowing asset with no money down during the lowest-income years of your medical career.</p></div></div><!-- Canyon Creek --><div class="bsw-card bsw-fade-in"><div class="bsw-card__header"><h3 class="bsw-h3">Canyon Creek</h3><span class="bsw-card__price">$140K–$500K+</span></div><div class="bsw-card__tags"><span class="bsw-tag--emerald bsw-tag">5–7 Min</span><span class="bsw-tag">Temple ISD</span><span class="bsw-tag">HOA $30–$45/mo</span></div><dl class="bsw-card__grid"><dt>Cimarron</dt><dd>$140K–$175K (entry point)</dd><dt>Mid Canyon Creek</dt><dd>$225K–$275K</dd><dt>Cliffs at Canyon Creek</dt><dd>$400K–$500K</dd><dt>Strata</dt><dd>$1M+ (luxury)</dd></dl><p class="bsw-body" style="margin-top:12px;">The widest price range of any single neighborhood in Temple. Canyon Creek effectively has four sub-neighborhoods under one name, which means a PGY-1 resident and a department head can both live here. Modern brick-on-slab construction, mature trees, parks, and a quick straight shot east on Adams Avenue to BSW. This is the default recommendation for BSW employees who want to stay in Temple ISD.</p><p class="bsw-body"><strong>Best for:</strong> All BSW employees — the price range covers every career stage.</p><div class="bsw-card__negative">Short-term rentals require a Special Use Permit in Temple. Don’t plan on Airbnb-ing your Canyon Creek home without going through the permitting process first.</div><a href="/canyon-creek-temple-tx/" class="bsw-card__link">Full Canyon Creek neighborhood guide →</a></div><!-- Bella Terra --><div class="bsw-card bsw-fade-in"><div class="bsw-card__header"><h3 class="bsw-h3">Bella Terra</h3><span class="bsw-card__price">$300K–$350K</span></div><div class="bsw-card__tags"><span class="bsw-tag--emerald bsw-tag">5–8 Min</span><span class="bsw-tag">Temple ISD</span><span class="bsw-tag">HOA $40–$50/mo</span></div><dl class="bsw-card__grid"><dt>Builder</dt><dd>Carothers</dd><dt>Amenities</dt><dd>Basketball court, park area</dd><dt>Construction</dt><dd>2015+ builds, brick, slab-on-grade</dd><dt>Commute</dt><dd>5–8 minutes to BSW</dd></dl><p class="bsw-body" style="margin-top:12px;">Tight price band and a single builder keep Bella Terra consistent. Every home was built by Carothers, so you know what you’re getting — good quality brick construction without the wild variation you see in larger subdivisions. The neighborhood is compact, quiet, and popular with young attending physicians and dual-income professional couples who want something newer without a long commute.</p><p class="bsw-body"><strong>Best for:</strong> Young professionals, early attendings, dual-income couples without kids.</p><a href="/bella-terra-temple-tx/" class="bsw-card__link">Full Bella Terra neighborhood guide →</a></div><!-- Legacy Ranch --><div class="bsw-card bsw-fade-in"><div class="bsw-card__header"><h3 class="bsw-h3">Legacy Ranch</h3><span class="bsw-card__price">$450K–$700K</span></div><div class="bsw-card__tags"><span class="bsw-tag--emerald bsw-tag">7–10 Min</span><span class="bsw-tag">Temple ISD</span><span class="bsw-tag">HOA ~$46/mo</span></div><p class="bsw-body">Master-planned community with larger lots and premium finishes. Legacy Ranch is where established BSW physicians land when they want to stay in Temple ISD but want the lot size and build quality that approaches luxury territory. Close enough to BSW for a quick commute, far enough west to feel like you have breathing room.</p><p class="bsw-body"><strong>Best for:</strong> Established attendings, families who want premium homes in Temple ISD.</p><a href="/legacy-ranch-temple-tx/" class="bsw-card__link">Full Legacy Ranch neighborhood guide →</a></div><!-- Hospital District / South Odd Streets --><div class="bsw-card bsw-fade-in"><div class="bsw-card__header"><h3 class="bsw-h3">Hospital District / South Odd Streets</h3><span class="bsw-card__price">$140K–$185K</span></div><div class="bsw-card__tags"><span class="bsw-tag--emerald bsw-tag">3–4 Min</span><span class="bsw-tag">Temple ISD</span><span class="bsw-tag--warning bsw-tag">Inspection Required</span></div><dl class="bsw-card__grid"><dt>Housing</dt><dd>1950s pier and beam</dd><dt>HOA</dt><dd>$0 — none</dd><dt>Rental Restrictions</dt><dd>None</dd><dt>Commute</dt><dd>3–4 minutes to BSW</dd></dl><p class="bsw-body" style="margin-top:12px;">The absolute closest neighborhood to BSW Temple. These are 1950s pier-and-beam homes — no HOA, no rental restrictions, and the lowest prices you will find within walking distance of a Level I Trauma Center. The tradeoff is clear: these are old homes that require a thorough inspection. Foundation, plumbing, and electrical are the three things that will cost you if you skip due diligence.</p><p class="bsw-body"><strong>Best for:</strong> Night shift workers, first-time buyers, investors.</p><div class="bsw-card__negative">Pier-and-beam foundation homes in this area require careful inspection. Budget $5K–$15K for potential foundation, plumbing, or electrical repairs on any home built before 1960.</div></div></div></section><!-- Diamond Divider --><div class="bsw-diamond-divider" aria-hidden="true"><div class="bsw-diamond-divider__line"></div><div class="bsw-diamond"></div><div class="bsw-diamond-divider__line"></div></div><!-- ========== ZONE 2: 10-15 MINUTES ========== --><section class="bsw-section bsw-section--alt" aria-labelledby="bsw-zone2-heading"><div class="bsw-container"><div class="bsw-fade-in"><span class="bsw-chapter">Chapter II — Zone 2</span><h2 class="bsw-h2" id="bsw-zone2-heading">10–15 Minutes from BSW</h2><p class="bsw-body">This is the sweet spot for most BSW families. You trade 5 extra minutes of commute for Belton ISD schools, newer construction, more amenities, and significantly more home for your money. The majority of BSW physicians, nurses, and staff settle in this zone.</p></div><img src="https://assets.agentfire3.com/uploads/sites/2128/2026/03/family-home.png" alt="Family neighborhoods near BSW Temple" class="bsw-zone-img bsw-fade-in" width="1140" height="280" loading="lazy"><div class="bsw-gem-box bsw-fade-in"><div class="bsw-gem-box__title">Little Gem — The West Temple Paradox</div><p class="bsw-gem-box__body">City limits and school district boundaries do not match in Central Texas. A home with a Temple mailing address is often zoned for Belton ISD. Most BSW employees end up in “West Temple” — their address says Temple, their property taxes go to Temple, but their kids attend Belton ISD schools. This overlap is the most sought-after combination in Bell County, and it’s the primary reason West Temple property values outperform the rest of the city.</p></div><!-- Sage Meadows --><div class="bsw-card bsw-fade-in"><div class="bsw-card__header"><h3 class="bsw-h3">Sage Meadows</h3><span class="bsw-card__price">$270K–$325K</span></div><div class="bsw-card__tags"><span class="bsw-tag--emerald bsw-tag">5–10 Min</span><span class="bsw-tag">Belton ISD</span><span class="bsw-tag">HOA $190–$210/yr</span></div><dl class="bsw-card__grid"><dt>Price/sqft</dt><dd>~$130–$140/sqft</dd><dt>Schools</dt><dd>Pirtle Elementary, Lake Belton Middle, Lake Belton High</dd><dt>Construction</dt><dd>Brick single-family, 2018+</dd><dt>HOA</dt><dd>$190–$210/year (low)</dd></dl><p class="bsw-body" style="margin-top:12px;">The most popular neighborhood for incoming BSW residents and fellows. The price point is accessible on a resident’s salary with a physician loan, the HOA is annual (not monthly), and you get Belton ISD — specifically, Lake Belton High School, which earned an A rating from TEA in 2025. Brick single-family homes, clean streets, and a commute that rarely hits double digits.</p><p class="bsw-body"><strong>Best for:</strong> Residents, fellows, young attendings, nurses.</p></div><!-- Hills of Westwood --><div class="bsw-card bsw-fade-in"><div class="bsw-card__header"><h3 class="bsw-h3">Hills of Westwood</h3><span class="bsw-card__price">$315K–$415K+</span></div><div class="bsw-card__tags"><span class="bsw-tag--emerald bsw-tag">8–12 Min</span><span class="bsw-tag">Belton ISD</span><span class="bsw-tag">Community Pool</span></div><dl class="bsw-card__grid"><dt>Builders</dt><dd>Omega, Kiella</dd><dt>Master HOA</dt><dd>~$180/year</dd><dt>Enclave (gated)</dt><dd>~$125/month</dd><dt>Nearby</dt><dd>H-E-B, Target, gyms, Summer Moon Coffee</dd></dl><p class="bsw-body" style="margin-top:12px;">The unofficial “BSW physician neighborhood.” Hills of Westwood has two tiers: the main subdivision with an annual HOA (~$180/year), and the Enclave — a gated section with a monthly HOA (~$125/month) and higher-end builds. Community pool, playground, and you’re a 3-minute drive from H-E-B, Target, Summer Moon Coffee, and multiple gyms. This is where the money lands for established attendings and specialists.</p><p class="bsw-body"><strong>Best for:</strong> Established attendings, specialists, dual-physician households.</p></div><!-- Mesa Ridge --><div class="bsw-card bsw-fade-in"><div class="bsw-card__header"><h3 class="bsw-h3">Mesa Ridge</h3><span class="bsw-card__price">$280K–$350K</span></div><div class="bsw-card__tags"><span class="bsw-tag--emerald bsw-tag">10–12 Min</span><span class="bsw-tag">Belton ISD</span><span class="bsw-tag">HOA $21/mo</span></div><p class="bsw-body">Solid mid-range option in the Belton ISD corridor. HOA is managed by Accent Real Estate at $21/month — low enough to be forgettable, high enough to maintain common areas. A practical choice for BSW families who want Belton ISD without stretching into the $400K+ range.</p><p class="bsw-body"><strong>Best for:</strong> Families, mid-career BSW staff.</p></div><!-- Groves at Lakewood Ranch --><div class="bsw-card bsw-fade-in"><div class="bsw-card__header"><h3 class="bsw-h3">Groves at Lakewood Ranch</h3><span class="bsw-card__price">$350K–$500K+</span></div><div class="bsw-card__tags"><span class="bsw-tag--emerald bsw-tag">12–15 Min</span><span class="bsw-tag">Belton ISD</span><span class="bsw-tag">Lake Belton Access</span></div><dl class="bsw-card__grid"><dt>Size</dt><dd>2,000–3,000 sqft</dd><dt>Finishes</dt><dd>Granite, custom cabinetry, upgraded</dd><dt>Schools</dt><dd>Lakewood Elementary (Belton ISD)</dd><dt>Amenities</dt><dd>Community pool, parks, Lake Belton access</dd></dl><p class="bsw-body" style="margin-top:12px;">The premium option in Zone 2. Lakewood Ranch homes are 2,000–3,000 sqft with granite countertops, custom cabinetry, and finishes that justify the price tag. Feeds into Lakewood Elementary, one of Belton ISD’s newer campuses. Community pool, parks, and proximity to Lake Belton for weekend recreation. This is where department heads, senior specialists, cardiologists, gastroenterologists, and CRNAs land.</p><p class="bsw-body"><strong>Best for:</strong> Department heads, senior specialists, CRNAs.</p></div></div></section><!-- Section Accent --><div class="bsw-section-accent" aria-hidden="true"></div><!-- ========== ZONE 3: 15-20 MINUTES ========== --><section class="bsw-section" aria-labelledby="bsw-zone3-heading"><div class="bsw-container"><div class="bsw-fade-in"><span class="bsw-chapter">Chapter III — Zone 3</span><h2 class="bsw-h2" id="bsw-zone3-heading">15–20 Minutes from BSW</h2><p class="bsw-body">You are trading commute time for space, newer construction, and a more rural feel. The surgeons and specialists who want half-acre lots with mature oaks and Belton charm live in this zone. The key routing trick: FM 1670 bypasses I-35 entirely.</p></div><!-- Three Creeks --><div class="bsw-card bsw-fade-in"><div class="bsw-card__header"><h3 class="bsw-h3">Three Creeks</h3><span class="bsw-card__price">$280K–$400K</span></div><div class="bsw-card__tags"><span class="bsw-tag--emerald bsw-tag">15–18 Min via FM 1670</span><span class="bsw-tag">Belton ISD</span><span class="bsw-tag">New Construction</span></div><dl class="bsw-card__grid"><dt>Builders</dt><dd>Stylecraft, D.R. Horton, Carothers Executive</dd><dt>HOA</dt><dd>~$120/quarter ($480/year); transfer $360</dd><dt>Amenities</dt><dd>Private pavilions, Lampasas River, hiking, sand volleyball</dd><dt>Commute Tip</dt><dd>FM 1670 avoids I-35 entirely</dd></dl><p class="bsw-body" style="margin-top:12px;">Three Creeks feels like a different world from West Temple. Lampasas River access, hiking trails, private pavilions, and sand volleyball courts — all within a master-planned community that has three active builders competing for your business. The 15–18 minute commute sounds long until you realize FM 1670 avoids I-35 entirely, so it’s a straight two-lane drive with zero highway stress. Belton ISD, new construction, and outdoor lifestyle at a price point that undercuts Hills of Westwood by $50K–$100K.</p><p class="bsw-body"><strong>Best for:</strong> Active families, outdoor enthusiasts, new construction buyers.</p></div><!-- Dawson Ranch --><div class="bsw-card bsw-fade-in"><div class="bsw-card__header"><h3 class="bsw-h3">Dawson Ranch</h3><span class="bsw-card__price">$400K–$750K+</span></div><div class="bsw-card__tags"><span class="bsw-tag--emerald bsw-tag">15–20 Min</span><span class="bsw-tag">Belton ISD</span><span class="bsw-tag">Half-Acre+ Lots</span></div><dl class="bsw-card__grid"><dt>Lot Size</dt><dd>Half-acre+ with mature oaks</dd><dt>HOA</dt><dd>~$180/year</dd><dt>Sub-section</dt><dd>Regatta Oaks (garden homes for empty nesters)</dd><dt>Premium for</dt><dd>Space, privacy, acreage</dd></dl><p class="bsw-body" style="margin-top:12px;">If you want the largest lots in the Belton ISD corridor, this is where they are. Half-acre-plus homesites with mature oaks, $180/year HOA, and prices that reflect the space. Regatta Oaks is a sub-section with smaller garden homes designed for empty nesters — surgeons whose kids have left but who don’t want to leave the Belton area. This is the “forever home” neighborhood for senior BSW physicians who are done moving.</p><p class="bsw-body"><strong>Best for:</strong> Department heads, senior specialists, CRNAs, surgeons.</p></div><!-- Highland Estates --><div class="bsw-card bsw-fade-in"><div class="bsw-card__header"><h3 class="bsw-h3">Highland Estates</h3><span class="bsw-card__price">$350K–$550K</span></div><div class="bsw-card__tags"><span class="bsw-tag--emerald bsw-tag">15–20 Min</span><span class="bsw-tag">Temple ISD</span><span class="bsw-tag">Near Belton Lake</span></div><dl class="bsw-card__grid"><dt>HOA</dt><dd>$14–$20/month</dd><dt>Lots</dt><dd>Nice lots, mature trees</dd><dt>Note</dt><dd>Lease copy required within 5 days</dd><dt>Lifestyle</dt><dd>Near Belton Lake for recreation</dd></dl><p class="bsw-body" style="margin-top:12px;">Good lots with mature trees and proximity to Belton Lake. Highland Estates lands in Temple ISD rather than Belton ISD, so factor that into your decision. The HOA is modest ($14–$20/month) but has a rule worth knowing: if you rent your home, you must provide a copy of the lease within 5 days. Solid option for BSW staff who prioritize outdoor recreation and larger lots over school district optimization.</p><p class="bsw-body"><strong>Best for:</strong> Lifestyle buyers, Lake Belton recreation, those fine with Temple ISD.</p></div></div></section><!-- Diamond Divider --><div class="bsw-diamond-divider" aria-hidden="true"><div class="bsw-diamond-divider__line"></div><div class="bsw-diamond"></div><div class="bsw-diamond-divider__line"></div></div><!-- ========== ZONE 4: 20+ MINUTES ========== --><section class="bsw-section bsw-section--alt" aria-labelledby="bsw-zone4-heading"><div class="bsw-container"><div class="bsw-fade-in"><span class="bsw-chapter">Chapter IV — Zone 4</span><h2 class="bsw-h2" id="bsw-zone4-heading">20+ Minutes from BSW</h2><p class="bsw-body">Beyond 20 minutes, you are making a deliberate lifestyle trade. These locations serve BSW staff who have specific reasons — military spouse stationed at Fort Hood, lake lifestyle commitment, or simply a willingness to commute for more house per dollar. They work. But verify your specific commute during rush hour before signing.</p></div><!-- Harker Heights --><div class="bsw-card bsw-fade-in"><div class="bsw-card__header"><h3 class="bsw-h3">Harker Heights</h3><span class="bsw-card__price">$350K–$500K</span></div><div class="bsw-card__tags"><span class="bsw-tag--emerald bsw-tag">15–20 Min via Hwy 190/I-14</span><span class="bsw-tag--warning bsw-tag">Killeen ISD</span><span class="bsw-tag">The Ridge • Country Trails</span></div><p class="bsw-body">Harker Heights makes sense for one specific household: dual-career military/medical. If one spouse works at BSW and the other is stationed at Fort Hood, Harker Heights splits the commute roughly evenly. The Ridge and Country Trails are the premium subdivisions. The tradeoff is Killeen ISD — which is improving but historically trails both Temple and Belton ISD in TEA ratings.</p><p class="bsw-body"><strong>Best for:</strong> Dual-career military/medical households.</p><a href="/fort-hood-bsw-temple-commute-housing/" class="bsw-card__link">Dual commute guide: Fort Hood + BSW →</a></div><!-- Morgan's Point Resort --><div class="bsw-card bsw-fade-in"><div class="bsw-card__header"><h3 class="bsw-h3">Morgan’s Point Resort</h3><span class="bsw-card__price">$160K–$800K+</span></div><div class="bsw-card__tags"><span class="bsw-tag--emerald bsw-tag">20+ Min</span><span class="bsw-tag">Temple ISD</span><span class="bsw-tag">Lakefront Available</span></div><dl class="bsw-card__grid"><dt>Entry Point</dt><dd>Condos from $160K with lake views</dd><dt>Condo HOA</dt><dd>~$300/month</dd><dt>Premium Lots</dt><dd>Lakefront from $400K–$800K+</dd><dt>STR</dt><dd>Special Use Permit required</dd></dl><p class="bsw-body" style="margin-top:12px;">Lake living 20+ minutes from BSW. The price range is extreme because Morgan’s Point includes everything from $160K condos with lake views to $800K+ lakefront estates. The condos come with ~$300/month HOA fees. Short-term rentals require a Special Use Permit.</p><p class="bsw-body"><strong>Best for:</strong> Lake lifestyle buyers, weekend warriors, those who value water access above commute time.</p><div class="bsw-card__negative">Older lots in Morgan’s Point have minimal deed restrictions and inconsistent maintenance. Drive every street in the section you’re considering before writing an offer — quality varies block by block.</div></div></div></section><!-- Section Accent --><div class="bsw-section-accent" aria-hidden="true"></div><!-- ========== CAREER STAGE MATCHER ========== --><section class="bsw-section bsw-glow" aria-labelledby="bsw-career-heading"><div class="bsw-container"><div class="bsw-fade-in"><span class="bsw-chapter">Chapter V — Career Stage Matcher</span><h2 class="bsw-h2" id="bsw-career-heading">Where Should You Live Based on Your BSW Role?</h2><p class="bsw-body">Your income, schedule, and career trajectory determine your housing fit more than personal preference. Here is where each BSW role maps to in Temple’s market — with real salary data and physician loan math.</p></div><div class="bsw-career-grid bsw-fade-in"><div class="bsw-career-card"><span class="bsw-career-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">🏫</span><div class="bsw-career-card__role">PGY-1 Residents</div><span class="bsw-career-card__salary">~$71K/year</span><p class="bsw-career-card__target"><strong>Target:</strong> The District ($150K–$250K) or lower Sage Meadows ($270K range)</p><p class="bsw-career-card__payment">Example: $260K home at 6.5% with a zero-down physician loan = ~$1,640/mo PITI. That’s 27.7% of gross income — within the physician loan qualification window.</p></div><div class="bsw-career-card"><span class="bsw-career-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">🏥</span><div class="bsw-career-card__role">Hospitalists / EM Physicians</div><span class="bsw-career-card__salary">$200K–$250K/year</span><p class="bsw-career-card__target"><strong>Target:</strong> Sage Meadows to Hills of Westwood ($270K–$415K)</p><p class="bsw-career-card__payment">Shift-based schedule means commute time matters less on paper — but after a 12-hour overnight, you want to be under 10 minutes from your bed. Neighborhoods: Canyon Creek, Bella Terra, Legacy Ranch, The District, Hospital District, Highland Estates.</p></div></div><div class="bsw-trap-box bsw-fade-in"><div class="bsw-trap-box__title"><svg viewbox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M10.29 3.86L1.82 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.71 3h16.94a2 2 0 0 0 1.71-3L13.71 3.86a2 2 0 0 0-3.42 0z"/><line x1="12" y1="9" x2="12" y2="13"/><line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"/></svg>

/* === TYPOGRAPHY === */
.bsw-h1 { font-family: var(--bsw-font-display); font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 4rem); font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--bsw-snow); margin-bottom: 20px; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.bsw-h1 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--bsw-emerald); font-weight: 400; text-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(5,150,105,.2); }
.bsw-h2 { font-family: var(--bsw-font-display); font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3.5vw, 2.6rem); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--bsw-snow); margin-bottom: 16px; }
.bsw-h3 { font-family: var(--bsw-font-display); font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 2.5vw, 1.7rem); font-weight: 600; color: var(--bsw-snow); margin-bottom: 12px; }
.bsw-label { font-family: var(--bsw-font-body); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--bsw-emerald); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.bsw-body { color: var(--bsw-light-gray); margin-bottom: 20px; line-height: 1.8; }

/* === HERO === */
.bsw-hero { position: relative; min-height: 100vh; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; overflow: hidden; }
.bsw-hero__bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; background: url('https://assets.agentfire3.com/uploads/sites/2128/2026/03/hero-2.png') center 40%/cover no-repeat; animation: bswHeroZoom 25s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
@keyframes bswHeroZoom { 0% { transform: scale(1); } 100% { transform: scale(1.08); } }
.bsw-hero__overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(15,23,42,.6) 0%, rgba(30,41,59,.75) 40%, rgba(15,23,42,.93) 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, rgba(5,150,105,.08) 0%, transparent 60%); }
.bsw-hero__content { position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 860px; padding: 2rem; animation: bswHeroFadeIn 1.5s ease-out; }
@keyframes bswHeroFadeIn { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(40px); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

.bsw-hero__corner { position: absolute; z-index: 2; width: 60px; height: 60px; opacity: .15; }
.bsw-hero__corner--tl { top: 2rem; left: 2rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--bsw-emerald); border-left: 1px solid var(--bsw-emerald); }
.bsw-hero__corner--tr { top: 2rem; right: 2rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--bsw-emerald); border-right: 1px solid var(--bsw-emerald); }
.bsw-hero__corner--bl { bottom: 2rem; left: 2rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bsw-emerald); border-left: 1px solid var(--bsw-emerald); }
.bsw-hero__corner--br { bottom: 2rem; right: 2rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bsw-emerald); border-right: 1px solid var(--bsw-emerald); }

.bsw-hero__breadcrumbs { font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: .15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--bsw-dim); margin-bottom: 1.5rem; animation: bswHeroFadeIn 1.8s ease-out .2s both; }
.bsw-hero__breadcrumbs a { color: var(--bsw-dim); }
.bsw-hero__breadcrumbs a:hover { color: var(--bsw-emerald); }
.bsw-hero__breadcrumbs span { margin: 0 8px; }

.bsw-hero__updated { display: inline-block; font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--bsw-emerald); background: rgba(5,150,105,.1); padding: 6px 18px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid rgba(5,150,105,.2); margin-bottom: 1.5rem; animation: bswHeroFadeIn 1.8s ease-out .3s both; }
.bsw-hero__tagline { font-family: var(--bsw-font-body); font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 300; color: var(--bsw-muted); max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto 2.5rem; line-height: 1.8; animation: bswHeroFadeIn 2s ease-out .6s both; }

.bsw-hero__scroll { position: absolute; bottom: 2.5rem; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 3; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; animation: bswBounce 2.5s infinite; }
.bsw-hero__scroll span { font-family: var(--bsw-font-body); font-size: .55rem; letter-spacing: .3em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--bsw-dim); }
.bsw-hero__scroll-line { width: 1px; height: 30px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--bsw-emerald), transparent); }
@keyframes bswBounce { 0%, 100% { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(8px); } }

.bsw-hero__ctas { display: flex; gap: 1.25rem; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; animation: bswHeroFadeIn 2.2s ease-out .8s both; }

/* === BUTTONS === */
.bsw-btn { display: inline-block; padding: .9rem 2.2rem; font-family: var(--bsw-font-body); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 3px; transition: all .35s var(--bsw-ease); cursor: pointer; position: relative; overflow: hidden; border: none; text-decoration: none; }
.bsw-btn::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.1), transparent); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .3s; }
.bsw-btn:hover::after { opacity: 1; }
.bsw-btn--primary { background: var(--bsw-emerald); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--bsw-emerald); box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(5,150,105,.2); }
.bsw-btn--primary:hover { background: var(--bsw-emerald-dark); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(5,150,105,.35); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.bsw-btn--ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--bsw-snow); border: 1px solid rgba(248,250,252,.2); }
.bsw-btn--ghost:hover { border-color: var(--bsw-emerald); color: var(--bsw-emerald); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(5,150,105,.1); }

/* === STAT STRIP === */
.bsw-stat-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 1px; background: var(--bsw-card-border); border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; margin: 40px 0; }
.bsw-stat-strip__item { background: var(--bsw-card-bg); padding: 28px 20px; text-align: center; transition: background .3s var(--bsw-ease); }
.bsw-stat-strip__item:hover { background: rgba(5,150,105,.06); }
.bsw-stat-strip__number { font-family: var(--bsw-font-body); font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3vw, 2.4rem); font-weight: 700; color: var(--bsw-emerald); line-height: 1.2; text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(5,150,105,.2); }
.bsw-stat-strip__desc { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--bsw-slate); margin-top: 6px; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: .03em; }

/* === AI ANSWER BOX === */
.bsw-ai-box { background: var(--bsw-ai-box-bg); border-left: 4px solid var(--bsw-emerald); border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0; padding: 36px 40px; margin: 36px 0; position: relative; box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(5,150,105,.06), 0 0 60px rgba(5,150,105,.03); }
.bsw-ai-box::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -1px; right: -1px; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-top: 1px solid var(--bsw-emerald); border-right: 1px solid var(--bsw-emerald); border-radius: 0 10px 0 0; opacity: .25; }
.bsw-ai-box__header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.bsw-ai-box__icon { width: 28px; height: 28px; fill: var(--bsw-emerald); flex-shrink: 0; }
.bsw-ai-box__title { font-family: var(--bsw-font-body); font-size: .65rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .25em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--bsw-emerald); }
.bsw-ai-box__question { font-family: var(--bsw-font-display); font-size: clamp(1.3rem, 2.5vw, 1.8rem); font-weight: 600; color: var(--bsw-snow); margin-bottom: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.3; }
.bsw-ai-box__answer { color: var(--bsw-muted); margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: .95rem; line-height: 1.8; }
.bsw-ai-box__list { list-style: none; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: .6rem; }
.bsw-ai-box__list li { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--bsw-muted); padding-left: 1.2rem; position: relative; line-height: 1.6; }
.bsw-ai-box__list li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: .55rem; width: 6px; height: 6px; background: var(--bsw-emerald); border-radius: 50%; }
.bsw-ai-box__list li strong { color: var(--bsw-emerald); font-weight: 600; }

/* === CARDS === */
.bsw-card { background: var(--bsw-card-bg); border: 1px solid var(--bsw-card-border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 36px; margin-bottom: 24px; transition: border-color .35s var(--bsw-ease), box-shadow .35s var(--bsw-ease), transform .35s var(--bsw-ease); position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.bsw-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 3px; background: var(--bsw-emerald); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .35s var(--bsw-ease); border-radius: 10px 0 0 10px; }
.bsw-card:hover { border-color: var(--bsw-emerald); box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(5,150,105,.08); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.bsw-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; }

.bsw-card__header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.bsw-card__price { font-family: var(--bsw-font-body); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bsw-emerald); background: rgba(5,150,105,.1); padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid rgba(5,150,105,.15); }
.bsw-card__tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin: 12px 0; }
.bsw-tag { font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(148,163,184,0.08); color: var(--bsw-slate); }
.bsw-tag--emerald { background: rgba(5,150,105,0.1); color: var(--bsw-emerald); border: 1px solid rgba(5,150,105,.15); }
.bsw-tag--warning { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.1); color: var(--bsw-amber); border: 1px solid rgba(245,158,11,.15); }

.bsw-card__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px 24px; font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--bsw-slate); margin: 16px 0; }
.bsw-card__grid dt { color: var(--bsw-slate); font-weight: 400; }
.bsw-card__grid dd { color: var(--bsw-light-gray); font-weight: 500; }

.bsw-card__negative { margin-top: 16px; padding: 14px 18px; background: rgba(245,158,11,.04); border: 1px solid rgba(245,158,11,.12); border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--bsw-amber); line-height: 1.6; }
.bsw-card__link { display: inline-block; margin-top: 14px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--bsw-emerald); border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; transition: border-color .3s var(--bsw-ease); }
.bsw-card__link:hover { border-bottom-color: var(--bsw-emerald); }

/* === ZONE IMAGE BANNER === */
.bsw-zone-img { width: 100%; height: 280px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 10px; margin-bottom: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--bsw-card-border); }

/* === COMPARISON TABLE === */
.bsw-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; margin: 32px 0; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--bsw-card-border); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.15); }
.bsw-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: .85rem; min-width: 800px; }
.bsw-table thead { background: var(--bsw-midnight-deep); }
.bsw-table th { padding: 16px 14px; font-weight: 600; font-size: .7rem; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--bsw-emerald); text-align: left; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--bsw-card-border); white-space: nowrap; }
.bsw-table td { padding: 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(45,74,107,.3); color: var(--bsw-light-gray); vertical-align: top; }
.bsw-table tbody tr { transition: background .2s var(--bsw-ease); }
.bsw-table tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(5,150,105,.04); }
.bsw-table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
.bsw-table .bsw-table__zone { font-size: .65rem; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--bsw-emerald); font-weight: 600; }

/* === CAREER STAGE MATCHER === */
.bsw-career-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr)); gap: 24px; margin: 32px 0; }
.bsw-career-card { background: var(--bsw-card-bg); border: 1px solid var(--bsw-card-border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 32px; transition: border-color .35s var(--bsw-ease), transform .35s var(--bsw-ease); }
.bsw-career-card:hover { border-color: var(--bsw-emerald); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.bsw-career-card__icon { font-size: 2rem; margin-bottom: 12px; display: block; }
.bsw-career-card__role { font-family: var(--bsw-font-display); font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bsw-snow); margin-bottom: 6px; }
.bsw-career-card__salary { font-size: .82rem; color: var(--bsw-emerald); font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 16px; display: block; }
.bsw-career-card__target { font-size: .88rem; color: var(--bsw-light-gray); margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.6; }
.bsw-career-card__payment { font-size: .82rem; color: var(--bsw-slate); margin-top: 12px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--bsw-card-border); line-height: 1.6; }

/* === LENDER CARDS === */
.bsw-lender-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); gap: 20px; margin: 32px 0; }
.bsw-lender-card { background: var(--bsw-card-bg); border: 1px solid var(--bsw-card-border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 28px; transition: border-color .35s var(--bsw-ease); }
.bsw-lender-card:hover { border-color: var(--bsw-emerald); }
.bsw-lender-card__name { font-family: var(--bsw-font-display); font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bsw-snow); margin-bottom: 10px; }
.bsw-lender-card__detail { font-size: .88rem; color: var(--bsw-light-gray); line-height: 1.7; }

/* === AMBER TRAP BOX === */
.bsw-trap-box { background: rgba(245,158,11,.04); border: 1px solid rgba(245,158,11,.2); border-left: 4px solid var(--bsw-amber); border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0; padding: 28px 32px; margin: 32px 0; }
.bsw-trap-box__title { font-family: var(--bsw-font-display); font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bsw-amber); margin-bottom: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.bsw-trap-box__body { font-size: .92rem; color: var(--bsw-muted); line-height: 1.8; }

/* === LITTLE GEM BOX === */
.bsw-gem-box { background: rgba(5,150,105,.04); border: 1px solid rgba(5,150,105,.15); border-left: 4px solid var(--bsw-emerald); border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0; padding: 24px 28px; margin: 28px 0; }
.bsw-gem-box__title { font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--bsw-emerald); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.bsw-gem-box__body { font-size: .9rem; color: var(--bsw-light-gray); line-height: 1.7; }

/* === TAYLOR'S TAKE === */
.bsw-taylor { display: flex; gap: 28px; align-items: flex-start; background: var(--bsw-card-bg); border: 1px solid var(--bsw-card-border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 40px; margin: 32px 0; }
.bsw-taylor__photo { width: 100px; height: 100px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 2px solid var(--bsw-emerald); flex-shrink: 0; }
.bsw-taylor__content { flex: 1; }
.bsw-taylor__name { font-family: var(--bsw-font-display); font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bsw-snow); margin-bottom: 4px; }
.bsw-taylor__title { font-size: .78rem; color: var(--bsw-emerald); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.bsw-taylor__text { font-size: .92rem; color: var(--bsw-light-gray); line-height: 1.8; }

/* === YOUTUBE EMBED === */
.bsw-video-wrap { position: relative; width: 100%; padding-bottom: 56.25%; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; margin: 32px 0; border: 1px solid var(--bsw-card-border); box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.2); }
.bsw-video-wrap iframe { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: none; }

/* === RELATED GUIDES GRID === */
.bsw-guides-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; margin: 32px 0; }
.bsw-guide-card { background: var(--bsw-card-bg); border: 1px solid var(--bsw-card-border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 24px; transition: all .35s var(--bsw-ease); text-decoration: none; display: block; }
.bsw-guide-card:hover { border-color: var(--bsw-emerald); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(5,150,105,.08); color: var(--bsw-snow); }
.bsw-guide-card__title { font-family: var(--bsw-font-display); font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bsw-snow); margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.3; }
.bsw-guide-card__desc { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--bsw-slate); line-height: 1.5; }

/* === FAQ === */
.bsw-faq-item { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bsw-card-border); }
.bsw-faq-input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; pointer-events: none; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); overflow: hidden; }
.bsw-faq-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 22px 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--bsw-font-display); font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.25rem); font-weight: 600; color: var(--bsw-snow); transition: color .3s var(--bsw-ease); line-height: 1.4; }
.bsw-faq-label:hover { color: var(--bsw-emerald); }
.bsw-faq-label__icon { width: 24px; height: 24px; flex-shrink: 0; margin-left: 16px; transition: transform .3s var(--bsw-ease); color: var(--bsw-emerald); }
.bsw-faq-input:checked ~ .bsw-faq-label .bsw-faq-label__icon { transform: rotate(45deg); }
.bsw-faq-answer { max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; transition: max-height .5s var(--bsw-ease), padding .3s var(--bsw-ease); }
.bsw-faq-input:checked ~ .bsw-faq-answer { max-height: 500px; padding-bottom: 22px; }
.bsw-faq-answer p { font-size: .92rem; color: var(--bsw-muted); line-height: 1.8; }

/* === SCHOOL COMPARISON === */
.bsw-school-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 24px; margin: 24px 0; }
.bsw-school-card { background: var(--bsw-card-bg); border: 1px solid var(--bsw-card-border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 28px; }
.bsw-school-card__name { font-family: var(--bsw-font-display); font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bsw-snow); margin-bottom: 12px; }
.bsw-school-card__body { font-size: .88rem; color: var(--bsw-light-gray); line-height: 1.7; }

/* === CTA SECTION === */
.bsw-cta { text-align: center; max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; }
.bsw-cta__title { font-family: var(--bsw-font-display); font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.5vw, 2.6rem); font-weight: 600; color: var(--bsw-snow); margin-bottom: 16px; }
.bsw-cta__sub { font-size: .95rem; color: var(--bsw-muted); line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 32px; }
.bsw-cta__buttons { display: flex; gap: 1.25rem; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 32px; }

.bsw-contact { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; justify-content: center; margin-top: 24px; }
.bsw-contact__photo { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 2px solid var(--bsw-emerald); }
.bsw-contact__info { text-align: left; font-size: .85rem; color: var(--bsw-slate); line-height: 1.6; }
.bsw-contact__name { font-weight: 600; color: var(--bsw-snow); }

/* === FOOTER === */
.bsw-footer { padding: 40px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--bsw-card-border); text-align: center; }
.bsw-footer__links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.bsw-footer__links a { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--bsw-slate); }
.bsw-footer__links a:hover { color: var(--bsw-emerald); }
.bsw-footer__copy { font-size: .72rem; color: var(--bsw-dim); line-height: 1.8; }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .bsw-section { padding: 60px 0; }
  .bsw-career-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .bsw-school-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .bsw-taylor { flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; }
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .bsw-stat-strip { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .bsw-ai-box { padding: 24px 20px; }
  .bsw-ai-box__list { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .bsw-card { padding: 24px; }
  .bsw-hero__ctas { flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
  .bsw-career-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .bsw-lender-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .bsw-guides-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .bsw-zone-img { height: 200px; }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .bsw-container { padding: 0 16px; }
  .bsw-section { padding: 48px 0; }
  .bsw-hero__corner { display: none; }
  .bsw-card__grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .bsw-taylor { padding: 24px; }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .bsw-stat-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .bsw-btn { width: 100%; text-align: center; }
  .bsw-cta__buttons { flex-direction: column; }
}
@media (max-width: 380px) {
  body { font-size: 15px; }
  .bsw-hero__tagline { font-size: .85rem; }
}

/* === REDUCED MOTION === */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }

This concentration of medical employment is why housing demand near BSW stays structurally high regardless of broader market cycles. When 20% of your city works at one campus, that campus dictates real estate patterns.</p>

The 15–18 minute commute sounds long until you realize FM 1670 avoids I-35 entirely, so it’s a straight two-lane drive with zero highway stress. Belton ISD, new construction, and outdoor lifestyle at a price point that undercuts Hills of Westwood by $50K–$100K.</p>

<!-- ========== CAREER STAGE MATCHER ========== -->
<section class="bsw-section bsw-glow" aria-labelledby="bsw-career-heading">

      <span class="bsw-chapter">Chapter V — Career Stage Matcher</span>
      <h2 class="bsw-h2" id="bsw-career-heading">Where Should You Live Based on Your BSW Role?</h2>
      <p class="bsw-body">Your income, schedule, and career trajectory determine your housing fit more than personal preference. Here is where each BSW role maps to in Temple’s market — with real salary data and physician loan math.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="bsw-career-grid bsw-fade-in">

      <div class="bsw-career-card">
        <span class="bsw-career-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">🏫</span>
        <div class="bsw-career-card__role">PGY-1 Residents</div>
        <span class="bsw-career-card__salary">~$71K/year</span>
        <p class="bsw-career-card__target"><strong>Target:</strong> The District ($150K–$250K) or lower Sage Meadows ($270K range)</p>
        <p class="bsw-career-card__payment">Example: $260K home at 6.5% with a zero-down physician loan = ~$1,640/mo PITI. That’s 27.7% of gross income — within the physician loan qualification window.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="bsw-career-card">
        <span class="bsw-career-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">🏥</span>
        <div class="bsw-career-card__role">Hospitalists / EM Physicians</div>
        <span class="bsw-career-card__salary">$200K–$250K/year</span>
        <p class="bsw-career-card__target"><strong>Target:</strong> Sage Meadows to Hills of Westwood ($270K–$415K)</p>
        <p class="bsw-career-card__payment">Shift-based schedule means commute time matters less on paper — but after a 12-hour overnight, you want to be under 10 minutes from your bed. Sage Meadows and Canyon Creek are the default.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="bsw-career-card">
        <span class="bsw-career-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">🩺</span>
        <div class="bsw-career-card__role">Specialists / Surgeons</div>
        <span class="bsw-career-card__salary">$341K+ /year</span>
        <p class="bsw-career-card__target"><strong>Target:</strong> Lakewood Ranch, Dawson Ranch, Three Creeks custom ($350K–$750K+)</p>
        <p class="bsw-career-card__payment">At this income, you have full access to the premium tier. The decision is lifestyle: do you want a community pool and convenience (Lakewood Ranch), half-acre privacy (Dawson Ranch), or outdoor amenities (Three Creeks)?</p>
      </div>

      <div class="bsw-career-card">
        <span class="bsw-career-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">🩹</span>
        <div class="bsw-career-card__role">Registered Nurses (RNs)</div>
        <span class="bsw-career-card__salary">$60K–$82K/year</span>
        <p class="bsw-career-card__target"><strong>Target:</strong> The District ($150K–$250K) or lower Sage Meadows / Canyon Creek Cimarron ($140K–$270K)</p>
        <p class="bsw-career-card__payment">Temple’s median home price of $255K is accessible on a single RN income with conventional financing. Focus on the sub-$250K tier in Zone 1 for maximum commute efficiency.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="bsw-career-card">
        <span class="bsw-career-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">👫</span>
        <div class="bsw-career-card__role">Dual-Income RN Households</div>
        <span class="bsw-career-card__salary">$120K–$164K combined</span>
        <p class="bsw-career-card__target"><strong>Target:</strong> Full West Temple range ($225K–$400K) — Canyon Creek mid-tier through Hills of Westwood</p>
        <p class="bsw-career-card__payment">Two-nurse households unlock the full Belton ISD corridor. If both work at BSW, prioritize Zone 1–2 to coordinate shift schedules.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="bsw-career-card">
        <span class="bsw-career-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">💪</span>
        <div class="bsw-career-card__role">CRNAs</div>
        <span class="bsw-career-card__salary">~$388K/year</span>
        <p class="bsw-career-card__target"><strong>Target:</strong> Dawson Ranch or Three Creeks custom ($400K–$750K+)</p>
        <p class="bsw-career-card__payment">CRNAs are among the highest-paid non-physician roles in the hospital. At $388K, you are shopping the same neighborhoods as surgeons. Dawson Ranch for privacy, Three Creeks for outdoor lifestyle.</p>
      </div>

    </div>

    <div class="bsw-gem-box bsw-fade-in">
      <div class="bsw-gem-box__title">Little Gem — The July 1 Inventory Crunch</div>
      <p class="bsw-gem-box__body">Residency start dates cluster on July 1 every year. This means 30–50+ incoming BSW residents all hit the Temple housing market in the same 60-day window. If you matched at BSW, start your pre-approval 90 days before your start date. By May, the best homes in the $250K–$325K range near BSW are already under contract. Every year, residents who wait until June settle for their third or fourth choice.</p>

      <span class="bsw-chapter">Chapter VIII — School Districts</span>
      <h2 class="bsw-h2" id="bsw-school-heading">Belton ISD vs Temple ISD for BSW Families</h2>
      <p class="bsw-body">This is the single most important decision for BSW families with school-age children. Both districts serve the Temple area, but they are not the same.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="bsw-school-grid bsw-fade-in">
      <div class="bsw-school-card">
        <div class="bsw-school-card__name">Belton ISD</div>
        <p class="bsw-school-card__body">Consistently A/B TEA ratings. Lake Belton High School opened in 2020 and earned an A rating in 2025 — it is the newest high school in the corridor and feeds from the West Temple neighborhoods. Fast-growing district with newer facilities, stronger test scores, and the preferred choice for the majority of BSW physician families. Neighborhoods: Sage Meadows, Hills of Westwood, Mesa Ridge, Groves at Lakewood Ranch, Three Creeks, Dawson Ranch.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="bsw-school-card">
        <div class="bsw-school-card__name">Temple ISD</div>
        <p class="bsw-school-card__body">Generally B/C TEA ratings. Temple High School has an International Baccalaureate (IB) program — one of the few in Central Texas — plus strong career and technical tracks. If your child is IB-bound, Temple ISD has a specific advantage. Neighborhoods: Canyon Creek, Bella Terra, Legacy Ranch, The District, Hospital District, Highland Estates.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="bsw-trap-box bsw-fade-in">
      <div class="bsw-trap-box__title">
        <svg viewbox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M10.29 3.86L1.82 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.71 3h16.94a2 2 0 0 0 1.71-3L13.71 3.86a2 2 0 0 0-3.42 0z"/><line x1="12" y1="9" x2="12" y2="13"/><line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"/></svg>
        School District Boundary Warning
      </div>
      <p class="bsw-trap-box__body">City limits and school district boundaries do not match in Central Texas. A home with a Temple mailing address can be zoned for Belton ISD, Temple ISD, or even Academy ISD. Do not assume. Every offer should include school district verification — I check this on every single transaction for BSW clients.</p>

<!-- ========== LEVEL I TRAUMA WARNING ========== -->
<section class="bsw-section bsw-section--alt" aria-labelledby="bsw-trauma-heading">
  <div class="bsw-container">
    <div class="bsw-fade-in">
      <span class="bsw-chapter">Critical Factor</span>
      <h2 class="bsw-h2" id="bsw-trauma-heading">Level I Trauma Response — The Hard Border</h2>
    </div>

    <div class="bsw-trap-box bsw-fade-in">
      <div class="bsw-trap-box__title">
        <svg viewbox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M10.29 3.86L1.82 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.71 3h16.94a2 2 0 0 0 1.71-3L13.71 3.86a2 2 0 0 0-3.42 0z"/><line x1="12" y1="9" x2="12" y2="13"/><line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"/></svg>
        Level I Trauma Call Restriction
      </div>
